jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title**

Staff Engineer – senior individual contributor (no line management)

**Company**

Landmark Systems Ltd

**Location**

Pulborough, West Sussex/(Hybrid \- 2\-3 days on\-site

**Reports To**

Chief Technology Officer

**Salary**

Dependent on experience, circa £65\-£75K

**About Landmark Systems**

Landmark Systems has been providing specialist accounting and business management software to UK farmers for over 39 years. Our KEYPrime desktop software is trusted by thousands of farms across the country. We’re rebuilding years of hard\-won agricultural domain knowledge as a modern, cloud\-native SaaS product, and we’re looking for a Staff Engineer to help us get the big technical decisions right.

**The Opportunity**

Our next\-generation product is cloud\-native, not cloud\-ported. That means genuinely interesting problems, not a lift\-and\-shift:

· **Multi\-tenancy done properly** — from single farms to multi\-entity groups, accountancy practices and resellers. How we model tenants, organisations and licenses is a live architectural question, and you’d help answer it.

· **A model\-driven platform** — much of the product is generated from a declarative metadata layer that produces both the .NET back end and the Vue front end. Knowing when to work with that grain and when to build a bespoke escape hatch is a real craft.

· **AI as a first\-class capability** — our platform ships with semantic search, retrieval and agent tooling built in. We expect our engineers to build with AI, and to build AI\-backed features into the product itself.

· **A long, deliberate migration** — moving a loyal, established customer base from a mature desktop product to the cloud, without breaking the trust that took 25 years to earn.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own the hard technical decisions end to end — multi\-tenancy, data modelling, platform trade\-offs.

· Set the technical direction on the problems that matter most and bring the rest of the team with you.

· Elevate the performance of those around you : coaching senior engineers, strengthening how we design, review and ship.

· Lead the solution architecture conversations — bringing engineering, product and domain experts into the room and guiding them to decisions everyone trusts.

· Work pragmatically inside a vendor platform we don’t fully control — pushing it where it helps, working around it where it doesn’t.

· Be the person who gets to the bottom of the hard problems — the intermittent, cross\-layer, “nobody knows why” bugs that span generated code, data, tenancy and infrastructure.

· Build AI\-native workflows into both how we engineer and what our customers use.

**Essential Requirements**

· 5\+ years of senior web engineering leadership — setting technical direction and owning decisions on web/SaaS products — though we care far more about the calibre of your judgement than the number on your CV.

· Deep, current full\-stack experience across **.NET / C\#** and a modern front\-end framework with **TypeScript** — React, Angular or Vue. We build on Vue 3, but strong React or Angular engineers are just as welcome.

· A track record of **owning consequential architecture decisions under ambiguity** — and being right often enough to be trusted with the next one.

· Real experience of **multi\-tenant SaaS** and **cloud\-native delivery** on Azure (containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD).

· Exceptional **debugging and troubleshooting** instincts — you can reason from symptom to root cause across an unfamiliar, layered system.

· **Drive and initiative** — you move toward the hard problems and step up without being asked, motivated by shipping things customers value.

· The judgement to know **when** ***not*** **to engineer** — you build the right\-sized solution, resist gold\-plating, and ship rather than polish.

· **AI\-native engineering** — you already build with AI tooling, and you can design LLM\-backed product features (retrieval, semantic search, agents).

· The judgement and influence of someone who lifts a team rather than just out\-codes it — a natural coach who leads solution architecture discussions and brings people with them.

· Comfort evolving an established product toward cloud\-native without losing what makes it valuable.

**Our stack**

.NET / C\# · Vue 3 · TypeScript · Vite · Pinia · PostgreSQL · multi\-tenant SaaS · Azure · Kubernetes · Azure DevOps · real\-time messaging · a built\-in AI stack (semantic search, retrieval, agents).

**Why join us**

· Real problems and real ownership — you’ll shape the solution architecture.

· A rare mix: an established, profitable business with a genuine build\-from\-scratch product mission.

· A small, capable team where a Staff Engineer’s judgement carries real weight.

· Backing from a larger European agricultural software group.

· Hybrid working from our Pulborough

**What We Offer**

* The chance to shape a product used by thousands of UK farmers
* Investment in your development
* Yearly Performance bonus/Share of the Profits (if business delivers on profit)
* Hybrid working — 2\-3 days per week in our Pulborough office/home working
* Holiday allowance to include "birthday holiday" and office closure during Xmas period
* Pension scheme (5% employer contribution after qualifying period)
* Death in service
* Enhanced sick pay
* Private Health Insurance
* Company Events
* Nice office environment, casual dress code
* Free on\-site parking, near train station

**Landmark Systems Ltd** is an equal opportunities employer.

Pay: £65,000\.00\-£75,000\.00 per year

* Casual dress

* Resolve production bugs and work through the engineering backlog to improve platform reliability and performance

We would also imagine that you have:

  

* 7\+ years of experience in software product development with cloud\-based systems (design, build, deploy, and maintain)
* Strong skills in building data processing pipelines — including data import, transformation, cleansing, and calculation workflows
* Demonstrated experience with architectural design of scalable framework components in a production environment
* Proven ability to work autonomously in small agile/scrum teams and deliver iterative releases

  

It is a plus if you also have

  

* Experience with analytics or IoT platforms, particularly in utilities, water management, or industrial domains
* Familiarity with dashboard development and alert/notification systems
* Background working with third\-party data integrations and building extensible framework products

 **Why you will love working here**

  

We care! Day to day, you can look forward to:

  

* A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.
* Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well\-being activities.

As an **IT Infrastructure Engineer** at Cabot Credit Management, you will play a key role in delivering and supporting robust, secure, and scalable technology services across our organisation. With a primary focus on UK operations and an awareness of wider European business needs, you’ll take a hands\-on approach to infrastructure support, system administration, and project delivery.


Operating within our IT Operations team, you’ll provide expert 3rd line support and technical leadership across a diverse technology landscape \- proactively troubleshooting, optimising systems, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure our IT services remain reliable, resilient, and fit for the future.

**What you can expect as an Infrastructure Engineer:**

* Permanent
* Hybrid role from our Kings Hill office, Kent. ME19 4UA.


Not only are we offering a competitive salary and a fantastic bonus scheme, you’ll also be entitled to loads of great benefits including, discount and cash back on hundreds of high\-street shops and private health insurance, plus much more.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Ensure high availability, reliability, and security are embedded across infrastructure and service delivery.
* Lead vulnerability management, patching, and preventative maintenance across platforms.
* Provide technical leadership and 3rd line support, resolving complex and high\-impact incidents.
* Review, validate, and contribute to infrastructure design and project delivery.
* Support IT governance, compliance, and audits (including SOX, PCI\-DSS), ensuring adherence to controls and regulations.
* Operate within ITIL frameworks, managing incidents, problems, and changes effectively.
* Plan and execute disaster recovery testing to ensure business continuity.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise systems to maintain performance and integrity.
* Collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and vendors to deliver and support services.
* Integrate security and best practice into all technology and lifecycle decisions.
* Support ongoing system administration, service improvements, and out\-of\-hours escalation where required.

**We are looking for someone with:**

**Essential:**

* Expert level NetApp Ontap and AFF skills
* Strong expertise in Windows Server platforms.
* Experience with VMware and Microsoft AVD
* Microsoft Exchange (2016/2019 Hybrid), Office 365, and PowerShell scripting.
* Dell Server Hardware knowledge
* Veeam Backup and Replication
* Web technologies (IIS, .NET).
* Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DFS, DHCP, WINS.
* Windows/SQL clustering.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and service management.

**Desirable:**

* Azure administration (servers, storage, networking).
* Office 365 support (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint).
* Intune device management.
* Security tools (CrowdStrike, Rapid7\).
* Experience in financial services environments.
* Monitoring tools (e.g., PRTG).
* Azure Entra administration.
* Ivanti patching and deployment.
* Certifications (Preferred):
* MCSE, VCP, VMCE, NCDA

**What happens next?**

If this sounds like you and you’d like to join our rapidly expanding company that offers excellent career progression, then apply now!

**Working for Cabot:**


You’ll be working for an award winning; Investors in People Gold accredited organisation. We’re passionate about the ethical treatment of our customers and employees. Our mission is to create pathways to economic freedom. Our vision is to make credit accessible by partnering with our consumers to restore their financial health.

**Diversity and inclusion** are very important to us at Cabot, and we value a multitude of diverse talent within our business. We want everyone to be themselves at work and encourage a culture that includes everyone. Our policies ensure that every candidate and employee are treated fairly and with equal opportunities.

*\*\*At Cabot we are highly regulated by our clients, as such, any successful candidates will have to undergo a basic credit check and criminal background check. Please note that we are unable to proceed to interview stage if a CCJ, IVA or Bankruptcy appears on a credit file, or if you do not have full right to work in the UK – we are unfortunately unable to offer sponsorship.*

If this sounds like you and you’d like to join our rapidly expanding company that offers excellent career progression, then apply now!

You’ll be working for an award winning; Investors in People Gold accredited organisation. We’re passionate about the ethical treatment of our customers and employees. jobs.title: Senior Graphics Engineer, Shader Systems
jobs.description:
**The opportunity**
-------------------


The Unity Engine is used by millions of creators around the world to build powerful and engaging real\-time experiences. At the heart of this is our flexible and powerful RT3D offering, giving users control from the initial point of content creation down to the final pixels on the target device.


In the graphics department, we focus on bringing pioneering graphics features to all the platforms Unity supports now and in the future! Our mission is to enable Unity developers to write rendering code without foreknowledge of what API it will ultimately be running on.


As a Senior Graphics Engineer on the Shader Systems team, you will be an integral part of collaborating with other graphics teams within Unity to improve workflows for artists and shader authors. This position will see you tackle problems across our shader tech stack, from runtime variant handling to dealing with our cross\-platform shader compiler systems and building new ways for developers to define their shader workflows.

**What you'll be doing**

* Develop and maintain high\-quality and performant shader management system
* Maintain existing systems, improving performance, testability and stability
* Work with multi\-functional teams to bring new engine features to all platforms
* Enable Unity shaders to work across platforms, render pipelines, and performance levels
* Build automated tests for new features and bug fixes

**What we are looking for**

* Demonstrated programming skills in C\+\+ and modern shader languages
* Knowledge of real\-time 3D graphics and Modern Graphics APIs
* Ability to collaborate with developers, customers, and leadership, both verbally and via documentation

**You might also have**

* Understanding of modern engine systems and rendering architectures and experience of working on real\-world productions or large multi\-platform engines
* Understanding of modern shader compilers (DXC, Slang) and IL such as DXIL, SPIR\-V, and MSL
* Familiarity with the Unity engine, C\# programming, and writing production shaders
* Familiarity with asset management, import, and build pipelines

jobs.title: Overhead Line (OHL) Engineer - Scotland (Energy)
jobs.description:
**What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?**

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.


horizons.


**A little more about your role…**

Scotland is playing a critical role in delivering the UK's future energy network.


Significant investment is being made in transmission infrastructure across the country, with major reinforcement programmes, new connections for renewable generation and strategic network upgrades helping to support Net Zero ambitions. Overhead line infrastructure will be central to this transformation, and WSP is supporting many of the projects that will shape the next generation of the UK's electricity network.


As a Senior Overhead Line Engineer, you will join a growing team delivering complex transmission projects across Scotland and the wider UK. Working from our Glasgow, Edinburgh or Perth offices, you will provide technical leadership on projects ranging from network reinforcement schemes through to major new transmission connections supporting offshore wind, renewable energy and grid infrastructure developments.


You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, environmental, planning and project delivery disciplines, helping clients develop and deliver safe, efficient and sustainable overhead line solutions.


This is an opportunity to play a leading role in some of the most significant energy infrastructure projects currently being developed across Scotland, while helping to grow and strengthen WSP's overhead line capability in the region.


**Why join our Scotland Energy Networks team?**

* **Help Deliver Scotland's Energy Transition** : Play a key role in developing the transmission infrastructure required to connect renewable generation and support the UK's journey to Net Zero.
* **Work on Major Infrastructure Projects** : Contribute to high\-profile overhead line projects ranging from 11kV to 400kV, supporting network operators, developers and major energy clients.
* **Build Local Capability** : Be part of WSP's continued investment in Scotland, helping to grow a strong local overhead line engineering capability across Glasgow, Edinburgh and Perth.
* **Technical Leadership Opportunities** : Share your expertise, mentor engineers and contribute to the development of best practice across a growing team.
* **Multidisciplinary Collaboration** : Work alongside specialists in substations, power systems, cables, environmental services, planning and asset management.
* **Professional Development** : Access structured development programmes, mentoring, Chartership support and opportunities to progress into technical, project or people leadership roles.
* **Flexible and Hybrid Working** : Balance local office collaboration with flexible working arrangements that support both project delivery and personal wellbeing.

**This is an excellent opportunity to…**

Join a growing overhead line engineering team delivering some of the UK's most strategically important electricity transmission projects, with particular focus on Scotland's expanding transmission network.


* Lead and support the delivery of overhead line engineering and design activities across transmission and distribution projects ranging from 11kV to 400kV.
* Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentoring to engineers within multidisciplinary project teams.
* Prepare technical reports, design documentation, specifications and engineering proposals to support project development and delivery.
* Undertake overhead line design activities including route development, PLS\-CADD modelling, structure spotting, clearance assessments, structure loading, conductor and insulator selection and line optimisation studies.
* Carry out sag\-tension calculations, blowout assessments, swing angle studies and other technical analyses required for overhead line design.
* Support feasibility studies and option assessments to identify technically preferred solutions for clients and stakeholders.
* Provide technical input during stakeholder engagement, statutory planning processes and public consultation activities.
* Review engineering deliverables and ensure designs comply with industry standards, client requirements and applicable regulations.
* Support project delivery through design reviews, technical assurance processes and quality management activities.
* Contribute to the development of innovative engineering solutions that improve performance, reduce risk and enhance constructability.
Actively contribute to technical excellence initiatives and industry forums, helping to shape the future of overhead line engineering.  
* 

**What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…**

* Degree qualified in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Power Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Demonstrable experience in the design and delivery of overhead transmission line projects up to 400kV.
* Strong understanding of overhead line design principles, including structure spotting, route optimisation, conductor selection, clearance assessments and line performance requirements.
* Experience supporting major transmission infrastructure projects, grid reinforcement schemes, renewable energy connections or wider energy network developments.
* Experience of conductor upgrade projects, including the application of High Temperature Low Sag (HTLS) conductor technologies and network optimisation solutions.
* Working knowledge of industry design standards, utility requirements and engineering best practice relating to overhead transmission systems.
* Experience using industry\-standard design tools such as PLS\-CADD, PLS\-TOWER and PLS\-POLE would be highly advantageous.
* Knowledge of advanced technical studies including conductor galloping assessments, EMF and field effects calculations, acoustic assessments, wake effects and AC interference studies would be beneficial.
* Ability to provide technical leadership and act as a trusted advisor to clients, project managers and engineering teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical discussions and build strong working relationships.
* Experience supporting or participating in technical committees, working groups and professional organisations such as CIGRE, IEEE or IET would be advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status (CEng), or a demonstrable commitment towards achieving professional registration.
* Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites and client locations across Scotland, the UK and internationally where required.
A passion for helping shape Scotland's future energy network and contributing to the continued growth of WSP's overhead line engineering capability across Glasgow, Edinburgh and Perth.  
* 

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**

Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.


**With us, you can. Apply today.**

\#LI\-DM1


  
We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long\-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**

**Work\-life balance**

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.


Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.


**Inclusivity \& Belonging**

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.


**Health \& Wellbeing**

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.


Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.


**Flex your time**

To enhance work\-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.


We also provide part\-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.


**Your development**

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.


**\#WeAreWSP**

*Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.*

Application Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Harris Health Alliance (HHA), a Harris Computer company, are currently recruiting for an Application Support Engineer on a permanent, full\-time, remote\-working basis.


The Application Support Engineer will join our Maternity brand K2 Medical Systems. This is an established role within the business, and you will become part of a growing team that supports our cloud\-based healthcare applications within Maternity, with new products and services currently being onboarded, it’s an exciting opportunity to help develop the role in the business.


The Application Support Engineer will be a core part of our support team, acting as an escalation point for 1st line queries as well as taking ownership of more complex, technical cases. You’ll triage, investigate and resolve issues across our cloud\-based healthcare applications, working towards full 2nd line capability – querying databases, reading error logs and diagnosing issues with .NET applications – while continuing to provide excellent front\-line customer service.


This is a developing role: you’ll be supported to grow your technical skillset over time, working closely with our 2nd/3rd line and engineering teams, while also mentoring newer colleagues as your own experience builds.


**Position \& Responsibilities**

In performing this role your core duties and responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to:


* Act as a point of contact for support queries via phone, email, and ITSM tools, escalating specialist or highly complex cases where required.
* Log, categorise, and triage tickets within SLAs.
* Provide troubleshooting and resolution for both common and more complex, escalated issues.
* Reproduce issues internally and liaise with developers regarding software defects.
* Support upgrades, patches, and configuration changes.
* Contribute to knowledge base articles, support documentation and root cause analysis.
* Deliver excellent customer service through clear, professional communication.
* Mentor colleagues by sharing technical knowledge as your own experience develops.
* At times support developers and/or technical client resources with further investigations.

**What we are looking for**

* **A positive Attitude and Aptitude –** We’re looking for someone with the drive, determination, and ability to expand their own horizons and to help others grow their career, with a positive can\-do attitude.
* **Engaged to represent our business –** Embody Our Values.
* **Preferably you’re accredited –** A degree with IT/scientific content or equivalent professional certification, relevant experience is also considered.
* **Eligible to work in the UK –** At the point of application.
* **Ability to work away on occasion –** At times you may need to attend a customer’s premises, it is highly desirable that you are able and willing to do so on occasion.

### **Required**

* Strong problem\-solving, analytical and diagnostic skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* A customer\-focused mindset with empathy, professionalism and a strong customer service ethos.
* Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
* Working knowledge of, or willingness to develop, SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) to support debugging, querying and data updates.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office applications (i.e. Outlook, Word, Excel).

### **Desirable**

* Exposure to IT support/helpdesk environments.
* Knowledge/experience of cloud service environments, e.g. Microsoft Azure.
* Familiarity with healthcare IT systems, NHS systems or other regulated environments.
* OS experience (Windows Server (2012 onwards), Kubernetes and some Linux).
* Existing knowledge of networking and web server troubleshooting.
* Experience of working within a Quality System.

Note: Regarding travel as part of this role, it is an expectation that at times you may need to attend a customer’s premises in performing this position.

HHA is a collaboration of companies, all working to provide software services to healthcare and government agencies. With specialist brands focusing on Maternity, Genetics, and health integrations.


Working at HHA will provide you with a competitive edge in your career and offer excellent growth opportunities. You will be an important member of our inclusive team and supported by our technical experts to develop the role and your own personal abilities.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

 **About the Role:**


CrowdStrike is looking for highly motivated, self\-driven, technical senior analysts dedicated to making a difference in global security by protecting organizations against the most advanced attackers in the world. Our Platform Professional Services team offers opportunities to expand your skill set through a wide variety of experiences detecting, analyzing, and responding to incidents.


Gold Standard is an elite team of security professionals built to help clients realize the maximum potential of the CrowdStrike Falcon platform. Through their engagements, the team drives optimal configurations of the platform and eliminates risk through detection triage and remediation. Through the power of Falcon, Platform Professional Services helps Stop Breaches.

**Am I a Sr. Analyst, Platform Professional Services Candidate?**

* Do you find yourself interested in putting your hands\-on technical skills to the test in detecting, containing, and remediating incidents?
* Are you self\-motivated and looking for an opportunity to rapidly accelerate your skills?
* Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to your customer?
* Do you have an Incident Response or Information Security background that you’re not fully utilizing.
* Do you work with EDR, DLP, Firewall, and/or SIEM technologies or desire to?
* Are you capable of leading teams and interacting well with customers
* Do you love working around like\-minded, smart people who you can learn from and mentor on a daily basis?
* Are you passionate about *stopping the breach?*

**What You’ll Do:**

* Exercise incident handling and remediation processes across Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms.
* Perform malware analysis across a variety of different customer environments full of new or emerging threats
* Develop and improve processes for incident detection and the execution of countermeasures
* Produce high\-quality written and verbal communications, recommendations, and findings to customers.
* Develop and implement security content and automations across multiple CrowdStrike modules including EDR/SIEM.
* Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts, CrowdCasts, and other public speaking events.
* Provide continuous feedback and solutions for operational collateral and capabilities.
* Provide consulting support in other areas of Platform Professional Services to assist clients in the onboarding and configuration of other Crowdstrike Falcon security modules.

**What You’ll Need:**


Successful candidates will have experience in multiple of the following areas:

* Working in a SOC, Malware Analysis or IR environment
* Incident Handling: experience conducting or managing incident response for organizations, investigating targeted threats such as the Advanced Persistent Threat, Organized Crime, and Hacktivists.
* Computer Forensic Analysis: a background using a variety of forensic analysis tools in incident response investigations to determine the extent and scope of compromise.
* Systems Administration: an understanding of system internals is required to understand how to implement and execute countermeasures and remediation.
* Network Forensic Analysis: knowledge of network protocols, network analysis tools, and ability to perform analysis of associated network logs.
* Malware Analysis: ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis to understand the nature of malware
* Incident Remediation: strong understanding of targeted attacks and able to create customized tactical and strategic remediation plans for compromised organizations.
* Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering: strong understanding of secure network architecture and strong background in performing network operations.
* Programming/Scripting: experience coding in Python, PowerShell, or .NET, or the desire to learn, with experience coding in other languages such as C, C\#, VB, Python, Perl, Ruby on Rails, etc
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

**Additionally, all candidates must possess the following qualifications:**

* Capable of completing technical tasks without supervision.
* Desire to grow and expand both technical and soft skills.
* Strong project management skills.
* Contributing thought leader within the incident response industry.
* Ability to foster a positive work environment and attitude.
* Desire and ability to effectively communicate with customers during ongoing security incidents.

**Education:**


If you have a BA or BS in Computer Science, or a degree in a related field, that’s great! If you have industry related DFIR certifications, that’s also a plus. If you have none of these \- show us what you’ve got, what you’re passionate about, and why you’d be a great fit for the team.

**Job Description:**

**What’s the role**

The Principal Architect for Trading \& Supply Data \& Analytics is accountable for defining and governing the architecture that enables T\&S’ data\-powered future. The role leads the design and evolution of an integrated data ecosystem that connects data, digital services, and enterprise intelligence at scale, ensuring that data and analytics capabilities are secure, reusable, interoperable, and aligned with business outcomes. The role collaborates on architectural guidance to organise and structure the delivery of AI use cases leveraging AI Platform foundational services.


A key accountability is the architecture, design, and implementation of the T\&S Data Platform landscape, providing the foundational capabilities required for trusted and AI\-ready data consumption. This includes ownership of the architectural direction, standards, integration patterns, and platforms. The role ensures these services are established as reusable T\&S capabilities.


The Principal Architect ensures solutions are architected once and leveraged many times, balancing innovation with governance, scalability, maintainability, and long\-term value creation. Working across the many parts of the T\&S business, data, digital, and technology teams, the role drives the adoption of common platforms, architectural patterns, and delivery approaches that accelerate business value realisation while reducing duplication and technical debt.


The Principal Architect is accountable for architecture direction, decision coherence and architecture outcomes across a connected set of domains, portfolios or enterprise transformation landscapes. The role translates business and enterprise strategy into target architectures, investment roadmaps, standards and guardrails, ensuring architecture decisions create enterprise value, reduce complexity and enable safe, scalable digital, data and analytics transformation.


**What you’ll be doing**

Key Accountabilities:


* Provides architecture leadership that aligns business strategy, enterprise architecture, and technology investments.
* Accountable for enterprise architecture direction and outcomes across a connected set of domains, portfolios or enterprise transformation landscapes, ensuring architecture decisions deliver enterprise value, coherence, resilience, security, scalability and simplification.
* Translates business and enterprise strategy into target architecture, strategic roadmaps, platform direction, standards, principles and guardrails across business process, application, data, integration, technology, cloud and security dimensions.
* Ensures cross\-domain architecture coherence, resolving conflicts between T\&S LoB domain strategies, product roadmaps, delivery priorities and enterprise target states.
* Acts as enterprise decision authority for material architecture choices spanning domains, portfolios or major transformation landscapes, including approval of significant trade\-offs, exceptions, deviations and step\-outs from enterprise guardrails.
* Represents architecture in executive governance forums, providing trusted advice to CIOs, business leaders, enterprise architects and senior technology stakeholders.

* Sets strategic technology direction for the supported enterprise landscape, including platform strategy, lifecycle choices, simplification themes, reuse priorities and emerging technology implications.

* Extensive IT experience, including senior architecture leadership roles.
* Experience across large\-scale, complex, multi\-domain technology environments.

jobs.title: Systems Support Engineer - London
jobs.description:
Welcome to ConocoPhillips, where innovation and excellence create a platform for opportunity and growth. Come realize your full potential here.


**Who We Are**

We are one of the world’s largest independent exploration and production companies, based on proved reserves and production of liquids and natural gas. With operations and activities in 13 countries, we explore for, develop, and produce crude oil and natural gas globally. We are challenged with an important job to safely find and deliver energy to the world. Our employees are critical to our success, and with them we power civilization.


We’re grounded by our SPIRIT Values – safety, people, integrity, responsibility, innovation, and teamwork. These values position us to deliver strong performance in a dynamic business – but not at all costs. We believe it’s not just what we do – it’s how we do it – that sets us apart.


**Fostering an Inclusive Work Environment**

To deliver superior performance, we create an environment that respects the contributions and differences of every individual. Wherever possible, we use these differences to drive competitive business advantage, personal growth and, ultimately, create business success.


**Job Summary**

The Systems Support Engineer sustains reliable non\-ETRM commercial applications supporting compliance, credit risk, market risk, pricing, custom solutions, data platforms, reporting, and integrations. The role restores service, implements controlled application changes, and supports continuity of global trading operations. The scope excludes platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, and core ETRM basis\-analysis responsibilities.
**Position Overview**

**Your responsibilities may include:**

* Monitor application health, trade and data flows, batch processing, interfaces, reporting, and downstream dependencies.
* Triage incidents, assess business impact, restore service, coordinate escalations, and communicate recovery status, workarounds, and next steps.
* Operate within a follow\-the\-sun model through structured handoffs, regional coordination, and end\-to\-end issue ownership.
* Maintain accurate support procedures and knowledge records.
* Meet service\-level commitments and comply with ITIL, security, change management, and operational controls.

**Technical Responsibilities:**

* Diagnose production issues across applications, Azure\-hosted components, APIs, integrations, databases, configuration, logs, messages, scheduled processes, and file transfers.
* Implement minor bug fixes, SQL corrections, configuration updates, and small enhancements using approved development practices.
* Validate data integrity and reconcile application, interface, pricing, risk, and reporting output during recovery.
* Coordinate deployments, environment readiness, release validation, rollback planning, smoke testing, and post\-release monitoring.
* Use source control, branching, pull requests, and CI/CD tooling to deliver changes safely.
* Document root\-cause evidence and recommend preventive or automated improvements.

**Success Profile**

To thrive in this role, you’ll demonstrate the following leadership competencies:


* **Takes Accountability:** Takes ownership of actions and follows through on commitments by courageously dealing with important problems, holding others accountable, and standing up for what is right.
* **Drives Performance:** Delivers results through realistic planning to accomplish goals.
* **Makes Decisions:** Generates effective solutions based on available information and makes timely decisions that are safe and ethical.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Management Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 or more years of experience supporting enterprise business applications in production.
* Intermediate level of experience providing Level 1 and Level 2 application support in a global or multi\-region operating environment.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (AWS)
jobs.description:
Thousands of hotels, resorts, and casinos around the world depend on Duetto's platform to run their revenue strategy — and you'll be one of the people making sure it never lets them down. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll own the infrastructure that powers our global SaaS platform: designing for scale, building for reliability, and driving the kind of security\-first culture that keeps us ahead of the curve. If you thrive in complex cloud environments, love solving hard problems, and want your work to have real, tangible impact — this is the role.


**What makes us different?**



Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue \& Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability.



Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the \#1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the \#1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025\. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI — and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.


**What you'll be doing**


* Design and implement robust, scalable AWS infrastructure — supporting key system migrations, platform growth, and the reliability our customers depend on.
* Own the reliability, performance, and security of our production environment: high uptime, rapid incident resolution, and proactive capacity planning.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and infrastructure\-as\-code using Terraform, Terragrunt, and Chef.
* Monitor system health using enterprise observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog), defining metrics and response playbooks that get ahead of incidents before they happen.
* Lead security\-first practices across the infrastructure estate — proactively addressing vulnerabilities and driving SOC 2 compliance.
* Partner with engineering teams to integrate operational requirements into the development lifecycle and align on architecture decisions.
* Champion AI adoption within DevOps and SRE workflows, evaluating tooling that increases team velocity and reduces toil.
* Respond to on\-call incidents with urgency — troubleshoot complex issues, lead detailed root cause analyses, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence.


**What we're looking for**


**You may be a great fit if you have:**


* 5\+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role.
* Hands\-on AWS experience across IAM, VPC, EC2, ELB, RDS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail — including multi\-account management and SSO.
* Proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure\-as\-code, plus experience with configuration management tools like Chef or Ansible.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling including GitHub, GitHub Actions, JFrog Artifactory, and Jenkins, with familiarity with GitOps methodologies.
* Experience with container and orchestration technologies — Docker, ECS, or EKS.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise monitoring platforms — Prometheus, Grafana, or DataDog.
* Solid troubleshooting skills and a track record of leading root cause analyses and implementing durable fixes.
* Proficiency reading Java, Ruby, Bash/Zsh, HCL, Python, and JavaScript.
* Experience with SOC 2 compliance and security\-first infrastructure practices.
* Comfort with a weekly on\-call rotation.


**Strong candidates may also have:**


* Experience migrating workloads from on\-prem or colocation environments to AWS.
* Familiarity with Windows Server, SQL Server, IIS, and .NET environments.
* Experience administering and synchronising MongoDB replica sets.
* Knowledge of ISO 27001, Layer 7 load balancing, or Terragrunt.
* Background in hospitality technology.
* A degree in Computer Science or a related field — or equivalent experience.


**Why Duetto?**


* **Infrastructure that matters —** your work directly underpins a platform that hotel operators around the world rely on every day. The stakes are real, and so is the satisfaction.
* **AI is how we work —** we're not just talking about AI adoption; we're actively investing in it across every function, including DevOps. You'll have space to evaluate and implement tooling that makes a genuine difference.
* **A team that moves fast —** you'll report into the Senior DevOps Manager and work alongside engineers who are serious about craft, reliability, and continuous improvement.
* **Growth with purpose —** backed by GrowthCurve Capital, we're scaling our platform and our team. There's a lot being built here, and senior engineers have real influence over how it's done.
* **Come as you are —** we're a diverse, distributed team that values different perspectives and builds inclusively.


**The details**


**Location:**Croatia


**Work model:**Remote


**Reports to:**Senior DevOps Manager

  


*Duetto is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*


**Sound like you?**



We'd love to hear from you — even if you don't tick every box. Diverse perspectives and non\-traditional paths make our team stronger. Apply and let's talk.

  



\#LI\-REMOTE

jobs.title: Repair Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title: **Repair Engineer**


Location: **TXO Group, Solihull, West Midlands \- Onsite Laboratory**


Reports to: **Group Repair Operations Manager**


Responsible for: **Testing, Diagnosing, and repairing parts in accordance with specifications and procedures.**

 **ABOUT US**


At TXO, we are transforming technology for a more sustainable future. Our people enable organisations worldwide to optimise and transform technology across its entire lifecycle, helping customers unlock value while reducing environmental impact through circular economy solutions.

  

Working at TXO means contributing to real\-world change. Our global teams support critical infrastructure for customers in more than 140 countries, extending the life of technology, reducing waste and helping organisations operate more sustainably. From engineering and operations to sales, finance, supply chain and corporate functions, every role plays a part in delivering meaningful impact.

  

We combine global reach with local expertise, creating opportunities to work on complex challenges across technology, commercial, operational and business disciplines. Our culture is built on collaboration, innovation and technical excellence, empowering our people to deliver practical solutions that make a measurable difference.

  

As we continue to grow globally, backed by TowerBrook Capital Partners' impact strategy, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where our people can develop, thrive and help shape the future of sustainable technology.

 **JOB FUNCTION**


Reporting to the Group Repair Operations Manager, this exciting new role is responsible for testing, diagnosing and, where capability exists, repairing parts in accordance with specifications and procedures. Assist with the design and implementation of new projects into the Repair Operations workshop and working with TXO and external customers to ensure the successful implementation of new products and services.

 **SKILLSET**

* Component\-Level Fault Finding
* PCB Repair \& Testing
* SMT \& Through\-Hole Soldering
* Electronics Diagnostics
* Reverse Engineering
* Hardware Testing \& Screening
* Electronics Maintenance

 **RESPONSIBILITIES**


The following outlines the primary areas of responsibility. Additional responsibilities or functions may be required as necessary to support the business.

  

* Follow all company Policies and Procedures including but not limited to Quality, Health \& Safety, Environment and Information Security.
* Expected to perform any reasonable requests which are not defined but in the ability of the individual
* Test and Repair customer equipment to client requirements
* Ensure that all test specifications are in line with manufacturers or industry standard
* Test, Repair, and Screen equipment and stock and return to working stock with correct identification or prepare dispatch documentation to return back to customers within agreed SLAs
* To effectively manage the handover of relevant projects into the workshop and oversee continuous improvement techniques to new and existing projects with the Repair Operations
* Document all test procedures and processes for the relevant projects and act as principal point of contact/ Subject Matter Expert (SME) of equipment and parts
* Working with wider repair team, to effectively train and develop other Repair Operations Engineers to meet the changing needs of the business and ensure a successful handover of new developments and individual Test Specifications ready to implement with the business
* To meet the needs of the defined budget and understand the financial constraints and parameters within which the projects need to be developed
* Assist with the development, maintenance and update of repair capability within the business
* Track all individual parts process through the screening centre, maintaining a record of equipment identifying and categorising as No\-Fault found/Fault identified; Last time part came into Repair Operations; Number of times part has been screened; Warranty status (where possible), etc
* Upgrade parts to be required revision of software and hardware
* Break\-down stock to lower order items and return to good stock as requested by client
* Build higher order part from lower order items on request from client and vice\-versa
* Self\-motivated to develop and increase product knowledge

 **ABOUT YOU**

  

* Extensive component level repair and screening / testing experience
* Good component understanding
* Ability to reverse engineer boards to understand design and functionality
* PDH/SDH equipment, Digital Microwave, Datacomms, Power supplies, GSM Base Station, Switching Systems
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills
* Sound knowledge of workshop techniques and safety practices
* Working under minimum supervision
* Ability to adapt to customer deadlines
* Enjoy a fast paced, a high\-change environment and don't rely on structure / hierarchy to get things done
* Challenger mindset, always looking to drive improvement
* Enthused by our business \- you like what you've seen of the TXO Group of companies, and you're motivated by the journey we're looking to go on in the coming years

 **REWARDS \& BENEFITS**

  

Working here, you'll receive an attractive salary and a range of competitive benefits, but \- more than that \- you'll be joining an ambitious organisation with a culture of togetherness, collaboration, and inclusivity, that takes a genuine and proactive interest in your progress and development.

  

* Up to £35,000 basic salary \+ bonus
* Overtime
* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays)
* Employee assistance programme
* Company events
* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
* On\-site free parking

 *Our top priorities are people, ethics, safety, and sustainability. With TXO Group brands, you are uniquely positioned to make a positive impact on global net\-zero targets. The driving force behind reaching these goals is our greatest asset: you. Our people come first, and our strength is in our diversity. Because diversity leads to fresh perspectives that drive performance and innovation!*

**Company Description**  

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for an enthusiastic Senior Software Engineer to work at the forefront of our cloud modernisation, within our Credit \& Verification Services reporting into our Engineering Director.


This is an incredibly exciting time for the Experian UKI Region, as we look to build our presence in the UK and Hyderabad and work on a technology transformation to meet our aspiration to significantly scale our business over the next five years.


Credit and Verification Services currently comprises nearly 100 engineering teams who deliver over 200 products achieving significant revenue per annum for our UK Business.


Our Tech:


We're predominantly a .NET focused engineering team, building modern, cloud\-native applications using the latest in .NET 8\+. All new services are developed with a forward\-looking mindset, and we actively evaluate emerging features and tools to continuously improve our engineering practices.


Our architecture is built on Kubernetes (EKS), enabling us to run scalable, resilient microservices in the cloud. On top of this, we leverage a wide range of AWS services (Lambda, Kinesis, Dynamo and RDS to name just a few), to enhance performance, observability, and integration across our platform.


You will be part of a high\-performance engineering team that delivers the product backlog of Ascend Cloud Foundation Platform. You will work closely with other Software Engineers to both maintain existing systems and build our cloud\-native microservices and web applications using the latest technologies and architectural patterns.

 **Qualifications**  

* Hands\-on experience with .NET 6\+ or .NET Core or .NET Framework building scalable, maintainable and performant REST/SOAP/RPC APIs with microservice or SOA architectures using ASP.NET with proficiency in C\#.

Company Description  

  

Legal \& General (L\&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.


**We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.**


We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.


**Who we are**


Our Retail business supports customers throughout their lives, to help them save, plan, protect and enjoy retirement.


We’re a leading provider of retirement and protection solutions. We aim to support our c.12\.8 million policyholders and workplace members throughout their lifelong financial journeys.


We focus on helping the customers of today and tomorrow achieve better long\-term outcomes. We either talk with them directly or work with intermediaries and employers to meet their needs. We use the latest technology to connect with them quickly, efficiently and wherever possible in highly personalised ways.

  

  

Job Description  

  

We’re looking for a Support Engineer to help keep our data services running smoothly. You’ll join a collaborative support team responsible for our Snowflake data warehouse, investigating pipeline issues, responding to internal queries and helping colleagues access the accurate data they need.


This is an opportunity to work with Snowflake, DBT, SQL and Azure technology in a varied environment where your troubleshooting and communication skills will be equally valued. We welcome candidates from different backgrounds who can demonstrate the relevant skills, even if they do not meet every desirable requirement.

* Monitoring scheduled ETL jobs and data ingestion pipelines
* Confirming that data has loaded successfully into Snowflake
* Investigating pipeline failures and coordinating timely resolutions
* Responding to incidents and service requests from internal colleagues
* Troubleshooting missing, incomplete or inconsistent data
* Supporting technical and non\-technical users with Snowflake queries
* Communicating progress and solutions in clear, accessible language
* Prioritising issues effectively within a fast\-paced support environment

Who we're looking for:


* Practical experience of working with Snowflake
* Good working knowledge of DBT
* Strong SQL skills
* Previous experience within a support or service desk environment
* Effective troubleshooting and analytical problem\-solving skills
* An approachable communication style and the ability to explain technical subjects clearly
* The ability to remain organised and make sound decisions under pressure
* Experience of Azure Data Factory or the wider Azure ecosystem would be beneficial

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:


* The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance \-related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
* Generous pension contribution
* Life assurance
* Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
* At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
* Competitive family leave
* Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand\-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
* There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
* We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience

At L\&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.


If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy with over 20,000 employees across more than 50 countries and 140\+ offices.

  

  

We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual.  



  

Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee\-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be **brilliant.**  



**About the business unit**
  

The Energy unit delivers services to clients globally across several sectors including hydropower, nuclear, waste, renewable generation and transmission \& distribution networks. Together we provide integrated engineering and project management services across the project lifecycle – from concept and design to construction and operations, to decommissioning or repowering and life extension. Together with our clients, we’re helping to deliver the energy transition globally.

  

**Overview of role**


The Energy Unit, specifically the Transmission \& Distribution division are recruiting for Electrical Engineers to join our team. This role is to support client projects from inception and master planning through concept and detailed design stages all the way to commissioning and final completion.


Our work is varied and spans across all forms of Renewable Power Generation, Network Design, Grid Connections, Net Zero Carbon aspirations and Estate Management Planning. We also provide detailed design solutions in the renewables, aviation, data centre, healthcare, nuclear and defence sectors.


Typical projects will include working from a client brief to produce tender specifications, calculations, designs and drawings for new or renovated 11kV and 33kV switchgear networks and renewable energy connections with HV cable connections, transformers, diesel generators, load banks, LV interfaces, SCADA interfaces and protection schemes.

  

Responsibilities:


The successful candidate will provide technical solutions and project leadership in the production of electrical designs for major electrical and multi\-disciplinary infrastructure works. You will be expected to become familiar with the company procedures and provide technical expertise and contributions to bids and proposals in addition to project planning, project delivery and execution to a high standard. You will manage engineering projects and deliverables ensuring they meet the client’s expectations and applicable statutory and regulatory specification, on time and within budget. You will also support and contribute to the development of junior staff and graduates


Typical activities include:


* Ensure project deliverables and scope are clear
* Understand procurement and contract awards such as NEC PSC
* LV and MV network configuration and advice on resilience issues.
* Input into the network configuration and understanding of operations scenarios and impacts.
* LV and MV (up to 33kV) network design.
* LV and MV cable sizing, routing and termination.
* LV and MV substation design layouts.
* LV and MV substation main equipment operations and specifications.
* Understanding and interpretation of client standards and DNO regulations and standards.
* Earthing designs including understanding of design, modelling and calculations for step, touch and transfer potential.
* Protection requirements
* Arc flash requirement
* Review of design submissions within the team against client scope.
  

**Candidate specification:**


Working as part of a Team and reporting to the Project Principal or Principal Engineer, we are ideally looking for candidates who are Chartered, along with:


* Professionally qualified in a relevant engineering discipline
* Proven skills, capabilities and experience in the sector areas mentioned above
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills are essential as the role will require preparation of specifications and reports.
* Co\-ordinate with multi disciplines both internal and external.
* Some experience within electrical project engineering, with focus on installations from LV up to 11kV / 33kV.
* Be competent in the use of MS packages.
* Be aware of and eventually contribute to bid procedures and internal governance.
* Be aware of procurement, construction and commissioning activities.
* Be able to travel in the UK and overseas if required,
* Must have initiative, self\-motivation and the confidence to make decisions.
  

We are actively recruiting a diverse workforce that is reflective of the communities we serve. We recognise that differences in ability, skills and experience are a strength and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

  

**Agile working**

At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well\-being, flexibility, and trust.

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion**


We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute.

  

**Accessibility**

We want you to perform your best at every stage in the recruitment process. If you are disabled or need any support to enable you to apply or attend an interview, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we will talk to you about how we can support you.

  

**We offer some fantastic benefits including:**

  

**Health and wellbeing**


* Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.
* Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.
* Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.
* A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
* Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.
  

**Financial wellbeing**


* We match employee pension contributions between 4\.5% and 7%.
* Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
* Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long\-term illness or injury.
* Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.
* As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.
  

**Lifestyle**

* A minimum of 33\-35 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme.
* Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service.
* Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high\-street retailers.
  

**Enhanced family and carers leave**


* Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave.
* Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay.
* Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid.
  

**Learning and development**


* Primary annual professional institution subscription.
* A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self\-development options.
  

**Networks, communities, and social outcomes**


* Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ\+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**Group Overview**

The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.


Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.


Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.


The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy \& Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all\-to\-all trading platform.


The Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,300 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.


**Role Overview**

TP ICAP has undertaken an ambitious program of modernization and Engineering maturity over the next three years. The program is global and across all divisions and applications. There is a desire to move towards faster, safer and more automated product delivery at scale. A key part of this program is to deliver automated CI/CD pipelines, increase developer productivity, shift left many of the traditional practices and deliver more change into production more reliably.


The candidate will be leading this uplift and modernization of engineering capabilities around automation of development, testing and production delivery for TP ICAPs platforms. The candidate will provide hands\-on as well as thought leadership in designing this strategy as well as executing with a combination of internal and external teams over the next two years. The candidate is able to educate and influence application development teams globally to adopt new tools and practices, and also demonstrate measurable improvements in productivity, time to market and operational resiliency.


The role requires a business minded, highly collaborative, team\-focussed experienced DevOps engineer with exceptional communication skills to work with developers and testers in DevOps principles.


**Role Responsibilities**

* Design DevOps modernization and adoption strategy incorporating current industry practices and technologies
* Engineer internal tooling to implement automation in software development, testing and production delivery
* Reduce manual overhead involved in software releases by fully automating delivery pipelines that includes testing
* Improve production stability and resiliency through process improvement and adoption of better observability tools
* Support application teams in adopting a consistent set of tools, practices and technology to support an agile delivery model, including automation and incremental delivery of software in test and production environments running in the cloud and on premises
* To operate at scale, engage with vendors and service providers to bring best in class industry practices, speed up internal build as well as accelerate companywide adoption of new tools and practices
* Assist and architect where appropriate solutions using containerisation and serverless technologies
* Drive automation for environment management, logging and monitoring
* To fulfil any additional / ad hoc duties as required to meet the needs of the business.

**Experience / Competences**

* Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science
* Over 5\-10 yrs experience in practising and leading DevOps practice in leading Financial or Technology companies
* Demonstrated experience leading and executing transformation programs involving significant uplift of DevOps and SDLC automation capabilities
* Experience delivering measurable process and productivity improvements via DevOps investments and driving a metrics driven practice of continuous improvement
* Intimately familiar with modern DevOps and SRE principles
* Deep and broad experience of AWS Cloud platform and services (Azue or GCP also considered)
* Previous experience in automating and integrating Testing into CI/CD pipelines (unit, integration, smoke testing)
* Previous experience working in development teams using Agile methodologies (e.g. SAFe) and practising Lean Delivery principles
* Knowledge of third\-party automation tools and technologies with relative pros and cons for all stages of SDLC, CI/CD pipelines and observability
* Platforms; Windows Server, Amazon Linux, RHEL, Ubuntu
* Proficiency in at least one of the following scripting languages; Python, GO, PowerShell, Bash, Groovy
* Programming language with a working knowledge in at least one of Java, C\# (.NET Framework/Core), JavaScript (Node.js), Ruby, C\+\+
* Developer tooling; Full stack CI/CD, GitLab, Jenkins, SonarQubeNexus
* Knowledge and working experience of containerising application components including writing DockerFiles and deploying to Kubernetes
* Deep understanding of pipelines as code
* Observability concepts and tooling; Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch

***Band \& Level – Manager, 6***

\#LI\-MID \#LI\-Hybrid \#NIJobs


**Not The Perfect Fit?**

Concerned that you may not meet the criteria precisely? At TP ICAP, we wholeheartedly believe in fostering inclusivity and cultivating a work environment where everyone can flourish, regardless of your personal or professional background. If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience doesn't align perfectly with every aspect of the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply. You may be the ideal candidate for this position or another opportunity within our organisation. Our dedicated Talent Acquisition team is here to assist you in recognising how your unique skills and abilities can be a valuable contribution. Don't hesitate to take the leap and explore the possibilities. Your potential is what truly matters to us.


**Company Statement**

We know that the best innovation happens when diverse people with different perspectives and skills work together in an inclusive atmosphere. That's why we're building a culture where everyone plays a part in making people feel welcome, ready and willing to contribute. TP ICAP Accord \- our Employee Network \- is a central to this. As well as representing specific groups, TP ICAP Accord helps increase awareness, collaboration, shares best practice, and holds our firm to account for driving continuous cultural improvement.


**Location**

UK \- City Quays 3 \- Belfast

**Our Package**

When you join our team, you'll play a role in delivering work that makes a real difference across the UK. In return, you'll be rewarded with a market\-leading Total Reward package that reflects the value of your skills and expertise. From structured technical progression and industry\-recognised training to generous family support and flexible benefits, we're committed to helping our people succeed at every stage of their career journey.


* A structured Technical Progression Pathway to recognise and reward appropriate technical people.
* Competitive DV market aligned salaries
* Tiered role based DV allowance of up to £5k per annum paid monthly
* World\-class training and development opportunities
