jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer
jobs.description:
We are an entertainment and content creation company powered by technology and pushing the boundaries of innovation and creativity to create world\-leading gaming content.


An ASX Listed company, headquartered in Sydney, Australia, we’ve grown from humble beginnings to boast more than 8,000 employees across 20 locations around the world, united by the common mission to *Bring Joy to Life Through the Power of Play*. Through our three operating units: Aristocrat Gaming, Product Madness, and Aristocrat Interactive (online RMG), we provide world\-leading mobile and casino games which entertain millions of players across the globe every day.


Connection and integrity are at the heart of everything we do. We put the wellbeing of our people first by giving employees the tools they need to grow, be inspired, and be the best they can be every day. We also strive to lead the way in responsible gameplay and set new standards in company governance and sustainability to support a better, brighter future – full of play.

**Summary**
-----------


We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer to join a multi\-functional agile team committed to building the core architecture and infrastructure of our next\-generation platform.


This is not just another feature team role. You will be chipping in to the foundation of a scalable, cloud\-ready system, designed to operate across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments.


You’ll work in a modern engineering ecosystem, using technologies such as .NET Core, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Redis, and Ably, while actively shaping how the system evolves toward a fully distributed microservices architecture.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Designing and developing scalable microservices from the ground up
* Contributing to the evolution of a cloud\-native, platform\-independent system
* Integrating legacy components into modern architecture
* Reverse\-engineering and gradually migrating monolithic parts into microservices
* Writing clean, maintainable code with strong focus on quality and testability (TDD)
* Participating in code reviews and driving engineering guidelines
* Collaborating closely with multi\-functional teams across product, QA, and DevOps

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 6\+ years of experience in backend development using .NET / .NET Core
* Hands\-on experience building large\-scale web\-based systems
* Solid understanding of microservices architecture
* Strong knowledge of relational databases
* Analytical attitude with strong problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work independently while being a reliable teammate
* Continuous learning approach and adaptability to new technologies
* Good written and verbal English communication skills
* Familiarity with AI agents and workflows

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* Familiarity with TDD and automated testing approaches
* Understanding of event\-driven architecture (Kafka, pub/sub patterns)
* Experience with database development and optimization

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================


We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay\-for\-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.  

  



Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.  

  



Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Open Banking Europe
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Engineer \- Open Banking Europe
Overview:  

Software engineers working on Mastercard’s Open Banking platform play a key role in the development and maintenance of the products that secure high quality connectivity to banks across Europe. Building on the strong foundation of our state\-of\-the\-art bank connectivity APIs, the engineers create turn\-key solutions that take the burden of handling account information and payment initiation services from customers that want to spend their efforts building great products that leverage the full potential of the Open Banking standard.  

  

Role:  

Open Banking engineers work at the bleeding edge of the account information and payment initiation technologies, often solving problems that are yet to be tackled within the industry in areas of API security, data accessibility, processing, and analysis. You will be joining a group of highly skilled individuals working together as a team to push the limits of what is possible to achieve with open banking.  

  

You will have many colleagues around different countries, with your nearest peers being located primarily in Denmark, Ireland and Poland.  

  

About you:  

We are looking for motivated individuals that are looking to be a part of an established team comprised of both industry veterans as well as newcomers. What they all have in common is the understanding that in order to achieve great things, being able to work together as a team is a must.  

You will be spending most of your time in the Microsoft domain, meaning APIs built in C\# with .NET (latest version) and ASP.NET deployed to the cloud (Azure, AWS). Deep knowledge of at least some of these areas is a requirement. However, we believe that learning is a part of the job, so if you for example have extensive experience building ASP.NET apps, but not in the cloud, do not hesitate to apply regardless.  

  

Beyond that, it is expected that you have experience building software using modern development standards, meaning it should not come as a surprise that we utilise all the tools at our disposal from standard ticketing systems (Azure DevOps), VCS, test automation, to CI/CD pipelines.  

Additionally, if you have experience with provisioning infrastructure as code (Terraform) as well as interest in computer security (Certificates, HTTPS) it would be a great benefit. Prior experience from working in closely regulated industries (financial, medical, etc.) is welcome, but not required.  

  

And above all, we hope that you love solving problems!**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Game Server Developer (Java / C\#)**  

**Location:** Hungary \- Remote / Sofia, Bulgaria \- Hybrid / Poland \- Remote  

**Employment Type:** Full\-time Employment  

**Division:** Technology  

**Reports to:** Game Server Development Team Lead

**Why Playnetic?**


Playnetic is an innovative and fast\-growing player in the iGaming industry. We create cutting\-edge casino games and technology that entertain millions of players worldwide, combining creativity, quality, and innovation at every step. Our gaming content is built around our core values: quality gaming, dedicated customer service, and reliable delivery to our partners.


With a global mindset, we’re committed to building engaging products and an inspiring workplace where teams can thrive.


Job Summary


We are looking for a Middle Java Game Server Developer to build and support backend services for real\-money casino games. You will work on core server\-side logic, game round processing, integrations, and performance improvements to ensure stable, secure, and scalable gameplay. This role is a great fit for an engineer who writes clean Java code, works well in cross\-functional teams, and takes ownership from development through release.


Key Responsibilities:

* Implement and maintain game server logic based on product and math/design requirements.
* Build resilient, maintainable Java code for core backend services and APIs.
* Ensure correctness of game rounds, bonus flows, and server\-side state transitions.
* Perform development verification, code reviews, and test coverage improvements.
* Fix bugs, optimize performance, and support production stability.
* Work according to Agile principles from planning to release (standups, grooming, retrospectives).
* Collaborate closely with client, product, QA, and platform teams.

Required Skills \& Experience

* 3\+ years of backend development experience with Java.
* Strong knowledge of Java Core, OOP, collections, and multithreading basics.
* Experience building and supporting REST APIs.
* Good understanding of SQL and transactional data handling.
* Familiarity with Git/GitLab, Maven, and CI/CD workflows.
* Strong English communication skills.
* Willingness to learn, curiosity, and ability to work with feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in iGaming/casino games, fintech, or other high\-reliability domains.
* Understanding of algorithms, design patterns, and SOLID principles.
* Experience with high\-load backend services and performance tuning.
* Familiarity with observability/logging tools.
* Basic knowledge of TypeScript is a plus.
**What we offer:**

* Real Impact: We’re small enough that your voice is heard — your contributions directly shape how we build, and you’ll have real opportunities to make your mark.
* Autonomy \& Ownership: We trust your expertise and give you the ownership to do your best work your way, with no micromanagement.
* Supportive Leadership \& Flat Hierarchy: A collaborative, open environment led by accessible managers who prioritize mentorship, psychological safety, and removing blockers.
* Fast\-Track Growth: As we scale, your career scales with us — we actively support professional development, training, and progression.
* Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and extra holiday for well\-being.

jobs.title: Senior MES Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.**

  


**Senior MES Software Engineer**

  


**For Digital Hub Warsaw, we are looking for:**

  


**Senior Software Engineer\- Agentic MES Software Development** to drives the adoption of AI\-powered and agentic software engineering practices within the Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) domain.

  



This role combines expertise in **Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI\-assisted software development, automation, cloud\-native engineering, and modern software delivery practices** with hands\-on experience in MES platforms, particularly **Siemens OpCenter**. The position is responsible for developing, integrating, and operating scalable MES solutions while leveraging emerging AI technologies to improve engineering productivity, accelerate software delivery, and enhance operational outcomes.



Working within a global product\-oriented environment, the Senior Software Engineer collaborates with product teams, architects, manufacturing stakeholders, automation engineers, and data professionals to deliver innovative and future\-ready digital manufacturing solutions.

  



At Bayer, we are committed to transparency, equal pay for equal work or work of equal value, and objective reward practices in line with EU and local regulations. The minimum monthly gross compensation for this role is 20 240 PLN, with final pay determined based on objective factors such as experience, qualifications, scope of responsibility, and internal alignment.

  



This position is eligible for variable pay components, such as performance based bonuses, awarded in accordance with the applicable employee group, role scope, and compensation structure

  


**Key Responsibilities**


**Agentic Software Development \& AI Enablement**


* Drive adoption of Agentic Software Development and AI\-assisted engineering practices.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to improve software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and knowledge management.
* Identify opportunities where AI copilots, intelligent agents, and automation can increase engineering productivity and software quality.
* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, data, and product teams to integrate AI\-enabled capabilities into software delivery processes.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical applications that deliver measurable business value.
* Ensure AI\-enabled solutions are implemented with appropriate governance, security, compliance, and human oversight.


**MES Solution Development**


* Design, develop, test, and maintain MES solutions based on Siemens OpCenter.
* Lead implementation of MES features, enhancements, and technical work packages.
* Support global MES template development and manufacturing site deployments.
* Ensure MES solutions are scalable, maintainable, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.


**Systems Design \& Integration**


* Design MES workflows, services, integrations, and interfaces supporting manufacturing processes.
* Develop and maintain integrations between MES, SAP, LIMS, automation systems, and enterprise platforms.
* Build APIs, middleware solutions, and event\-driven services.
* Support integration testing, validation, deployment, and release activities.
* Promote reusable integration patterns and standardization across the MES landscape.


**Software Engineering \& DevOps**

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Appgate · Core Team · Gothenburg, Sweden**

Want to build software where you can see the difference your work makes?


At Appgate, we develop IT security software that helps organizations control access to their applications and infrastructure. We’re looking for a senior fullstack developer with strong C\# experience to join our Core team, building the Appgate SDP client with C\# and React/TypeScript. You’ll also contribute to the Java REST backend that the same team works on.


We offer a balance that can be hard to find: a company large enough to surround you with experienced engineers, and small enough for your individual contribution to matter. Here, you can take ownership of substantial features and entire subsystems, help shape technical decisions, and follow your work from the first idea through to customers using it. Why Appgate? The people around you make a difference.


At Appgate, you’ll work with colleagues who bring deep experience in software development, networking and security. There are people to learn from, discuss difficult problems with, and help you explore unfamiliar areas.


At the same time, there is room to make your own mark. We value developers who ask questions, suggest improvements and take responsibility for moving things forward. As your knowledge of the product grows, so does your opportunity to influence it.


Appgate is growing, with major customer contracts driving expansion across our engineering teams. We’re also developing new capabilities in areas such as operational technology (OT), helping secure access to industrial systems. Joining now means contributing as those capabilities take shape.


We're also developing AI\-related capabilities in Appgate SDP. As a client and controller developer, you may contribute to how these features connect with the rest of the product, bringing new functionality into the applications and services you work on.

 **Requirements** **Your role in the Core team**


The Core team develops the client and controller at the heart of Appgate SDP.


The client is the software users interact with to connect securely. The controller manages the policies and access decisions that determine what they can reach.


**This is a fullstack role:** your work will span the client, its C\# logic and React/TypeScript interface, and the Java REST backend that powers it. You’ll move across this boundary regularly, understanding how a feature connects from backend logic through to what the user sees. 1 Appgate \| Core Team We use agentic AI tools as part of our development workflow and continue to explore where they can help us build, test and improve software. You'll have the opportunity to help shape how we use these tools, applying the same engineering judgment and attention to quality that we bring to the rest of our work.


**You’ll help us:**

* Develop features for the Appgate client, using C\#, React/TypeScript and Electron.
* Develop features for the Java REST backend.
* Investigate and resolve problems across applications, operating systems and networks.
* Improve automated testing, developer tooling and build and release workflows.
* Shape technical solutions through design discussions, code reviews and collaboration across teams.

**What you bring**

You enjoy building software, understanding how things work, and seeing a solution through. You’re comfortable taking initiative, while knowing when to involve others and work through a problem together.


**We’re looking for:**

• Strong professional experience with C\#. • Backend development experience, ideally with Java.


• Experience with, or working knowledge of, React, TypeScript and Electron. • Confidence supporting and debugging software across Windows, macOS and Linux.


• A working understanding of Unix systems. • An interest in writing maintainable code and improving how it is tested and delivered.


* Good communication skills in English.

 **Benefits**  

Build something, you can put your name to If you’re looking for room to grow, experienced colleagues to learn from, and the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a security product, we’d like to hear from you.


Join Appgate’s Core team and help shape what comes next.

jobs.title: Erfaren .NET-utvecklare till anti-penningtvätt
jobs.description:
**Att jobba som .NET\-utvecklare**


Vill du använda din erfarenhet inom .NET för att utveckla lösningar som spelar en viktig roll i arbetet mot penningtvätt?


Hos oss blir du en del av Team Norrsken i Piteå, ett erfaret och välfungerande team med stort ansvar för verksamhetskritiska lösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga kollegor och arbeta inom ett område som får allt större betydelse.


Några anledningar till att välja rollen:

* Ett uppdrag med tydligt syfte – du arbetar med lösningar inom bland annat antipenningtvätt och bidrar till utvecklingen av system som möter regulatoriska krav.
* Erfarna kollegor nära dig – du blir en del av ett kompetent team med seniora systemutvecklare, teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt och produktägare.
* Påverka både lösning och arbetssätt – du får vara delaktig från krav och design till utveckling, test och förvaltning.
* Möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas – på sikt finns möjligheter att bredda dig mot exempelvis arkitektur, Teamcoach, systemansvar eller systemspecialist.
* Gemenskap på kontoret i Piteå – teamet värdesätter samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och gemensamt ansvar, samtidigt som det finns möjlighet till ett flexibelt hybridarbete.


Vi är 9 personer i teamet som består av systemutvecklare, Scrum Master/Teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt samt systemspecialist. I teamet verkar även från verksamheten en produktägare (PO).


Vi arbetar agilt med dagliga avstämning. Uppgifter och prioriteringar hanteras i Azure DevOps. Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är vårt kontor centralt i Piteå. Vi ser ett värde i att arbeta tillsammans på plats, samtidigt som rollen erbjuder möjlighet till hybridarbete.


Tillsammans förvaltar och vidareutvecklar vi system inom bland annat antipenningtvätt, där produkten Actimize är en viktig del. I takt med utökade regulatoriska krav väntar fortsatt design och utveckling av tjänster inom området.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:

* utveckla och förvalta IT\-lösningar i C\#, .NET och .NET Framework
* delta i kravarbete och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
* bidra i designarbete med hänsyn till arkitektur, livscykel och roadmap
* arbeta med SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git och enhetstester
* genomföra testaktiviteter och bidra till ökad testautomation
* felsöka och lösa incidenter och problem samt analysera bakomliggande orsaker
* dokumentera lösningar och bidra till förbättringar av teknik, processer och teamets arbetssätt.

**För att lyckas i rollen**


Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet från en liknande roll och gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C\#och .NET. Du har även erfarenhet av MS SQL, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git, enhetstester och agila arbetssätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.


Som person är du självgående, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i teknik och verksamhet, förstå krav och omsätta dem till väl genomtänkta lösningar. Eftersom vi arbetar nära varandra behöver du också vara kommunikativ, dela med dig av kunskap och våga be om hjälp. Du bidrar med ett prestigelöst och positivt förhållningssätt där teamets gemensamma resultat står i fokus.


Det är meriterande med eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område samt erfarenhet av testautomation, händelsedrivna system, REST/SOAP, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy och felsökning i Splunk eller AppDynamics. Även kunskaper inom TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js och AI\-utveckling är meriterande.

**Vad händer nu?**


Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning.


Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen ta kontakt med madelene.skogh@skandia.se eller rekryterande chef på margit.ronn@skandia.se.


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

**Mer om Banken**


Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.


Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.

**Vårt erbjudande inkluderar:**
  

* **Låna:** Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
* **Spara:** Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
* **Betala:** Lönekonto samt smidiga kort\- och betalningstjänster.

Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

Tillsammans förvaltar och vidareutvecklar vi system inom bland annat antipenningtvätt, där produkten Actimize är en viktig del. I takt med utökade regulatoriska krav väntar fortsatt design och utveckling av tjänster inom området.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:


* utveckla och förvalta IT\-lösningar i C\#, .NET och .NET Framework
* delta i kravarbete och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
* bidra i designarbete med hänsyn till arkitektur, livscykel och roadmap
* arbeta med SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git och enhetstester
* genomföra testaktiviteter och bidra till ökad testautomation
* felsöka och lösa incidenter och problem samt analysera bakomliggande orsaker
* dokumentera lösningar och bidra till förbättringar av teknik, processer och teamets arbetssätt.

**För att lyckas i rollen**


Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet från en liknande roll och gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C\#och .NET. Du har även erfarenhet av MS SQL, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git, enhetstester och agila arbetssätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.


Som person är du självgående, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i teknik och verksamhet, förstå krav och omsätta dem till väl genomtänkta lösningar. Eftersom vi arbetar nära varandra behöver du också vara kommunikativ, dela med dig av kunskap och våga be om hjälp. Du bidrar med ett prestigelöst och positivt förhållningssätt där teamets gemensamma resultat står i fokus.


Det är meriterande med eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område samt erfarenhet av testautomation, händelsedrivna system, REST/SOAP, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy och felsökning i Splunk eller AppDynamics. Även kunskaper inom TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js och AI\-utveckling är meriterande.


**Vad händer nu?**


Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning.


Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen ta kontakt med madelene.skogh@skandia.se eller rekryterande chef på margit.ronn@skandia.se.


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!


**Mer om Banken**


Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.


Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.


**Vårt erbjudande inkluderar:**
  

* **Låna:** Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
* **Spara:** Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
* **Betala:** Lönekonto samt smidiga kort\- och betalningstjänster.

Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

jobs.title: Senior .NET-utvecklare
jobs.description:
#### **Senior .NET\-utvecklare med fokus på VB.NET och SQL Server på Kaplans Auktioner**


Vi söker en engagerad .NET\-utvecklare med god erfarenhet av VB.NET och SQL Server. Vår centrala interna applikation är uppbyggd i en kombination av Windows Forms och WPF (med XAML och MVVM). Rollen innebär ett varierat ansvar som omfattar både löpande förvaltning och nyutveckling inom båda ramverken. I rollen arbetar du nära verksamheten för att omsätta interna krav till stabila och affärsnära systemlösningar.


Teamet består idag av tre personer. Vi tillämpar en "Office First"\-filosofi, vilket innebär att arbetet sker på plats i våra lokaler – något vi värdesätter för att främja samarbete, dynamik och ett naturligt kunskapsutbyte.

###### **Ansvarsområden**

* Utveckla, underhålla och optimera våra applikationer, som är uppbyggda i en blandning av Windows Forms och WPF (med XAML \+ MVVM) i VB.NET.
* Ansvara för databasutveckling i SQL Server med primärt fokus på att skriva, optimera och underhålla lagrade procedurer (stored procedures) samt komplexa queries.
* Delta aktivt i allt från kravställning och design till utveckling, test, implementation och support.
* Säkerställa hög kodkvalitet genom versionshantering (Git) och kodgranskningar, samt förvalta och förbättra våra CI/CD\-pipelines i Azure DevOps.
* Dokumentera lösningar för att bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar i systemen och vårt gemensamma arbetssätt.

###### **Kvalifikationer**

* Flera års erfarenhet av VB.NET (.NET Framework) och Windows Forms i komplexa miljöer.
* God förståelse för eller erfarenhet av att arbeta med WPF, XAML och designmönstret MVVM.
* Stark kompetens inom SQL Server, med särskilt god erfarenhet av databasutveckling och optimering av lagrade procedurer.
* Goda kunskaper i Git samt erfarenhet av Azure DevOps (inklusive pipelines och CI/CD).
* God förmåga att sätta dig in i befintlig kod, förstå komplex affärslogik och se hur systemen bäst kan utvecklas framåt.

###### **Personliga egenskaper**

* Strukturerad och noggrann med ett öga för detaljer och kvalitet.
* Självständig och ansvarstagande med en naturlig drivkraft att föra projekt i mål.
* Kommunikativ lagspelare som trivs med att diskutera tekniska lösningar med både utvecklare och kollegor inom verksamheten.
* Nyfiken och lösningsorienterad med en vilja att ständigt lära dig nytt och utvecklas i din roll.

jobs.title: Senior Professional Resident Engineer
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29124
Category: Engineering \- Other
Job Type: Full\-time  

The **Networks \& Civil, Environmental Engineering Department (NCEE)** within Engineering and Major Projects provides a range of planning, design, construction, operation \& maintenance, and management services required for electricity industry infrastructure projects in Ireland


We are seeking an experienced and motivated **Resident Engineer** to join our Contract Manager Team within Networks Civil \& Environmental Engineering (NCEE). This role is critical to ensuring the successful delivery of civil works during the Construction phase of Networks Engineering projects.

  



The Resident Engineer will be primarily responsible for ensuring that the construction of our sub\-station projects, including major new sub\-station builds and upgrades within existing sub\-stations, in various locations in Ireland are completed safely to the required standard.  


The Resident Engineer will also be required to collaborate with our team to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, constructed safely, and with environmental compliance as well as commercial and contract adherence. You will play a key role in maintaining quality and safety standards, driving efficiency, and ensuring compliance with ESB’s engineering and environmental requirements.  


**Key Responsibilities**

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:


* Monitor and supervise all on\-site activities of our civil works contractors, especially for sub\-station construction projects.
* Ensure strong compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations and specific ESB requirements.
* Coordinate with Networks projects, Design Engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless project execution.
* Undertake Quality Assurance documentation and Site Inspection Test Plan reviews, audits and checks of the civil works on the site throughout the construction period.
* Resolve any issues or conflicts that arise on\-site promptly and effectively in collaboration with other project team members.
* Maintain accurate records of site activities, including daily logs, inspections, and incident reports.

  


**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**
**Essential**
* Minimum of seven years post\-graduate experience.
* Good understanding on the scoping, planning, design and construction phases of project work.
* Strong delivery and solution focus, in a commercially driven environment.
* Strong capability in assessing, communicating and managing project critical risks.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work on one’s own initiative while also collaborating strongly within a team
* The demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities.
* A flexible approach to work, especially where necessary to deliver excellent Stakeholder Management service.
* Experience in successfully managing contractors in their delivery of construction projects.
* Experience in carrying out inspections on projects.
* Self\-motivation and ability to project\-manage own work and coordinate with those working alongside.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including be able to write reports on issues found and ensure the issues are closed out
* Be proficient in the use of MS Office (incl Word, Excel Powerpoint, etc) and MS project

**Desirable**

* Chartered status in a recognised professional institution.
* Recent Experience in managing a team.

  


**Qualifications**
**Essential**
* A recognised level 8 degree in civil/structural Engineering or equivalent work experience.

  



**Location**  



This role is based in EMP Dublin but travel to and working at various project locations as required, is a key requirement of the role.  



ESB is committed to offering flexibility in ways of working and we call that Smart Working – combining digital tools with a culture of trust and empowerment to enable flexible and remote ways of working.  



The successful candidate may combine working from home within the Republic of Ireland, with attendance at base for in\-person collaboration, on at least 2 days per week. Site visits is also a feature of this role which will require a certain amount of travel within Ireland.  


**Reporting to**  



Contracts Manager Team Lead in Networks Civil \& Environmental Engineering  


**Why Work with Us?**
* Opportunity to lead Ireland’s transition to net zero carbon future
* Career development through mentoring and training
* Corporate Social Responsibility Opportunities
* Sports and Social Clubs
* Networking opportunities
* Credit Union
* Generous Pension
* Access to staff well\-being programmes
* Generous parental leave entitlements
* Strong values\-based and inclusive culture
* Strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion
* Great team environment working to our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Driven and Trusted

  


**Salary**

€59,000 \- €70,000 per annum  

**Closing Date**

29th Septmber 2026  



**Interview**

Candidates who are shortlisted for interview will complete a Behavioural Interview based on each of the following Behaviours, which underpin how we work at ESB and are critical to delivering our strategy:



* Accountable and Ethical
* Collaborative
* Growing and Adaptive
* Proactive
* Respectful and Supportive

  



More information available on Our People Promise

  

**Notes**



Your application will be held in reserve for 6 months should you be suitable for the role.



The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland / UK prior to commencement of employment.


**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement**


ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.


Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie.

Join us in our mission to achieve a net\-zero electricity system by 2040\. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. jobs.title: Senior Developer – C# .Net
jobs.description:
**Are you an experienced C\# .Net developer looking for the next big challenge?**
=================================================================================

We are on the lookout for someone like you to be part of a team of developers managing applications that are critical to both our business and our customers.


**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Senior Developer to take a leading role in driving the evolution of our Norwegian applications that support the core systems. These systems are very important to our business operations, and we’re seeking someone who can lead their continued development with technical excellence.


In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with key stakeholders including the Product Owner, Tribe Architect, IT Delivery Manager, and the Mainframe Centre of Excellence. Together, you’ll ensure that our solutions are aligned with If’s architectural principles. You will also have the opportunity to guide and mentor a team of skilled developers.


This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of the applications that support the core systems, contribute to modernizing legacy platforms, and make a lasting impact on how we deliver value to our customers.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the technical delivery within the Yggdrasil squad, ensuring design, development, and maintenance of stable and secure solutions.
* Translate business requirements into efficient technical solutions.
* Act as a bridge between business experts, technical developers in Norway and India, and architectural teams.
* Ensure consistent coding standards, version control, security and documentation practices.
* Drive adoption of modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing and monitoring.
* Drive modernization activities such as API enablement for integration between cloud\-based and mainframe systems and data replication using Change Data Capture (CDC).
* Ensure optimal usage and cost management of Azure resources.

**We offer**

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:


* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits
* Weekly workout hour
* High pension savings

**About the team**

The Core Tribe is responsible for maintaining and evolving our business\-critical insurance and claims systems. The Tribe operates cross\-functionally across Finland and Norway, organized into smaller squads combining business domain experts with IT professionals.


Our IT development teams include colleagues from If’s internal IT units as well as strategic partners such as Tata Consultancy Services, ensuring seamless collaboration across Norway and India.


Yggdrasil squad is one of the squads in the Core Tribe. The mission of this squad is to ensure the ecosystems of applications supporting the Policy and Claims systems within the Norwegian scope is viable, healthy and stable. As the Senior Developer for this squad, you’ll be responsible for maintaining and developing this ecosystem and strengthening our squad technical capabilities.


**Who are you?**

You are a technically strong and forward\-thinking developer with a passion for quality and long\-term solutions. You bring deep technical expertise and strong communication skills that enable you to develop effective, maintainable solutions and you collaborate well across roles.


You also take ownership of your work and continuously look for ways to improve. You understand the bigger picture, think with a long\-term and solution\-oriented mindset, and bring an architectural perspective when designing and evaluating solutions. In addition, you work in a collaborative, transparent, and pragmatic way when solving problems.


**In terms of technical experience, you have** :


* Solid experience with C\#, .NET, and Azure application development and maintenance.
* Familiarity with enterprise solutions, REST APIs, and message\-based architecture.
* Good knowledge and practical use of Infrastructure as Code (for example Terraform or Bicep).
* Hands\-on experience with tools such as Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with static code and security analysis tools such as SonarQube and Snyk.
* Experience applying OWASP Top 10 in design, development, and risk assessment of applications.
* Experience with authentication and authorization solutions including OAuth2, Curity and Identity Providers.

It´s a plus if you have:


* Experience working in an Agile setup, collaborating closely with product owners and business stakeholders.
* Python and Databricks competence.
* Familiarity with integration patterns between distributed systems and IBM z Mainframe.
* Experience with monitoring and observability using Dynatrace, Application Insights, Splunk or similar tools.
* Understanding of basic networking concepts including firewall rules and ability to use Wireshark for troubleshooting when needed.

**Additional facts and the recruitment process**
------------------------------------------------

**Application deadline:** Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is September 30th 2026\.


**To apply for the position:** Please attach your CV and answer the questions in the recruitment system


**Work location:** Oslo, Norway


**Travelling:** Some travelling might be involved


**Start:** As soon as possible, or by agreement.


For more information, please contact Santhosh Kumar, IT Deliver Manager, santhosh.kumar@if.no


*We use Semac for background checks for the final candidates.* *It is a requirement for the position that If’s extended fit \& proper requirements, including background checks, can be met.*

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Tech Advisor-Software Dev
jobs.description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


**Job Duties**
--------------


**About Landmark**

  

  

Landmark, a Halliburton company, builds the software and data platforms that help the global energy industry make better decisions. Our products span subsurface interpretation, well construction planning, reservoir simulation, production optimization, and digital operations. These are tools used daily by engineers and scientists at the world’s largest energy companies and run as cloud\-native SaaS platforms and as enterprise on\-premises solutions.
  

  

**About the Role**  



  

You are a senior developer with a designer's eye and in\-depth knowledge of computer graphics. You shape 3D engineering applications and digital twins, connecting back\-end data processing with real\-time rendering and 3D user experience (UX) design. Drawing on extensive experience with professional CAD and 3D software, you use established interaction patterns to make navigation, selection, and manipulation efficient, helping engineers stay oriented in complex models. You work across the full stack with Unity, WebGL, Three.js, Babylon.js, and modern web frameworks, taking solutions from prototypes through to production.  

  



**What You Will Do**


* Own the architecture and technical direction of the 3D component, working closely with product management and domain specialists.
* Design and build 3D and extended reality (XR) interactions for inspection, measurement, well planning, and collaboration.
* Develop processing pipelines, shaders, and reusable tools. Improve memory use, efficiency, and responsiveness with large datasets.
* Prepare and integrate CAD models, geospatial and subsurface data, point clouds, and volumetric datasets for accurate real\-time visualization.
* Lead design and code reviews, strengthen testing and debugging tools, and maintain the code through successive releases.

Evaluate and integrate AI where it improves engineering workflows, with attention to reliability, privacy, and cost.  
* 
**Qualifications**
------------------


* Masters’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
* 20 or more years of wide\-ranging experience across software development, computer graphics, and design
* Deep proficiency in Unity and C\#, with experience owning and improving a substantial real\-time 3D codebase
* In\-depth knowledge of rendering, shading, geometry, and performance optimization, supported by hands\-on 3D production experience
* Experience designing and implementing 3D and XR interactions, from user research and prototypes to testing with domain users
* Strong aesthetic judgment, including composition, lighting, materials, and visual hierarchy, applied to clear, usable engineering tools
* Experience converting and optimizing large CAD and geospatial datasets, including coordinate systems, terrain, and point clouds
* Communication skills sharp enough to explain a technical trade\-off to a product manager and a design choice to a junior engineer with equal clarity
* Practical knowledge of AI tools and model integration, including the capabilities and limitations of hosted and local models

**Preferred**


* Experience with WebGL, Three.js or Babylon.js, TypeScript, and full\-stack development with automated delivery using Git and Docker
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation
* Familiarity with geospatial coordinate systems and transformations, georeferencing, point clouds, and volumetric data such as voxel grids
* Experience with industrial digital twins, subsurface visualization, or collaborative VR tools.

Experience contributing to open\-source projects, or integrating open\-source components at scale.  
* 

**How You Work**


The senior engineer who succeeds in this role thinks at the level of the system, not only the feature. You work end to end, understanding how back\-end data, software architecture, real\-time graphics, and user interaction affect one another. You stay hands\-on from scoping through implementation and delivery. You explain technical choices clearly to developers, designers, domain experts, Product Management, and leadership, with the detail each needs to make a decision.

  

  

You bring the experience to know when a technical decision will cost the team later, the credibility to say so clearly, and the follow\-through to drive it toward a better outcome. You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and pragmatic enough to ship when the solution is sound, even if it is not perfect. You do not wait for someone to identify what needs fixing. You see it, own it, and drive it to resolution.
  

You stay technically sharp because you are genuinely curious, and you bring what you learn back to the team. You invest in the people around you because you understand that your long\-term contribution depends on the quality of the team, not only the quality of your own code.  

  



**Why Landmark**


We build small, high\-ownership teams and invest in the quality of every person on them. You will work in a business where software is the product, the work you do matters, and the standards are high. Here you have the autonomy to make real technical decisions, peers strong enough to challenge you, and problems deep enough to be worth solving well. We offer competitive compensation including bonus and long\-term incentive programs, a strong career path, and a role where your technical judgment shapes what gets built.  

  



Minimum Qualifications: Minimum qualifications may be acquired through technical schools or equivalent related experience. Candidates having qualifications that exceed the minimum job requirements will receive consideration for higher level roles given (1\) their experience, (2\) additional job requirements, and/or (3\) business needs. Depending on education, experience, and skill level, a variety of job opportunities might be available from the Software Engineer \- Snr


**Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.**


**Location**


Wergelandsveen 1, Oslo, , 0167, Norway


**Job Details**


**Requisition Number:** 211598
  

**Experience Level:** Experienced Hire
  

**Job Family:** Engineering/Science/Technology
  

**Product Service Line:** Landmark Software \& Services
  

**Full Time / Part Time:** Full\-time


**Additional Locations for this position:**


**Compensation Information**
  

Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Engineer/Software Developer
jobs.description:
As Senior Embedded Software Developer you will join our Development and Engineering team, currently consisting of 30 colleagues with various nationalities and educational backgrounds within electronic, firmware and mechanical design. We typically work in smaller groups together to get a holistic approach to our products and tools and to benefit from each other’s knowledge and expertise.


Department


Design \& Engineering


Location


Denmark, Allerød


Deadline


15\.10\.26


Reference


RCP\-001689


### **A world\-class company**



Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.



Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.



We develop and manufacture precision\-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.



We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting\-edge solutions.



Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state\-of\-the\-art technologies to provide services to our high\-profile clients in the region.



The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

  

### **The department**



As Senior Embedded Software Developer you will join our Development and Engineering team, currently consisting of 30 colleagues with various nationalities and educational backgrounds within electronic, firmware and mechanical design. We typically work in smaller groups together to get a holistic approach to our products and tools and to benefit from each other’s knowledge and expertise.



As a team, we support the global company, by providing customized high technological solutions and innovations while also sustaining the already existing technology. The work environment is informal, creative, fun, and with clear measurable targets. Furthermore, it can be challenging and hectic due to the nature of the industry we operate in but simultaneously rewarding and exciting as we solve real life challenges for customers globally.

  


### **The position**



The main success drivers in this position are to maintain and improve embedded firmware solutions to our existing and new intervention tools consisting of motors, sensors, actuators, valves and data communication infrastructure and therefore the overall architecture must be well structured. The Senior Embedded Engineer/Software Developer maintains and leads system architecture from embedded to cloud, specifications, implementation through to test and validation.  

  

Beside the technical tasks, you will act the technical lead together with another Senior Embedded Engineer and train other engineers in best practices and procedures related to embedded software. Furthermore, you will be in periods be the liaison between D\&E and 2\-3 external consultants who perform firmware related tasks for Welltec.

  

**As our new Senior Embedded Engineer/Software Developer you will:**


* Define, plan, lead, and implement data infrastructure connecting several devices
* Cooperate with sub\-contractors
* Co\-own the embedded software release process
* Participate in exhibition and forums related Data Protocols, Embedded Electronics, Sensor applications, motor\- and valvedrivers etc.
* Challenge the business with new ideas and concepts
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the Development and Engineering Department

  

### **The candidate**



You are a passionate Senior Embedded Engineer/Software Developer with strong experience in efficient data infrastructure ranging from low level serial communication to local network to cloud solutions.



You would like the challenge of creating reliable data connection for controlling and visualisation of robotic operations for extreme harsh environments. In addition, you get energized from working in close collaboration with the best hardware and firmware designers, consultants, and sub\-contractors.  

As a person, you are creative, practical, and organized in both the design and verification process of your system designs. Finally, you have a good overview of projects, tasks and stakeholder communication and like to take the lead on complex challenges to provide the best possible solution to your stakeholders. You like to assume responsibility and provide guidance to the team in order to ensure a consistent high quality of embedded software design and implementation.

  


**The preferred candidate has the following profile:**


* Master’s or bachelor’s degree and specialized in embedded software development
* Minimum 7 years’ of experience in embedded software, design and implementation
* Expierenced in selecting protocols for the different protocol layers
* Proactive with an energetic attitude towards implementing embedded software systems and continual improvements
* Ability to work in teams across departments
* Project management skills or flair


**The following technical skills and competencies are required:**


* Programming in C\+\+17, using STL, knowing design patterns
* Linux application programming under POSIX (threads, synchronization objects, IPC, sockets etc.)
* Familiar with TCP/IP, Ethernet, UART, CAN, USB under Linux
* Deep understanding of Realtime Operating Systems
* Code documentation with Doxygen
* Docker: build images, run containers, host\-container interface
* Working with git, svn, Azure DevOps, make, gcc and Linux server
* Professionalism in software design and architecture, system design
* Google unit\-testing on high level
* Microcontroller programming in C and assembler
* Bare metal software designs for microcontrollers
* Experienced in implememnting low level serial data protocols


**Further, it is an advantage but not a requirement if you are familiar with:**


* IOT and Automotive data protocols
* FPGA programming
* Experiences with MPLAB and dsPIC\-Microcontroller serie
* TMS320 and C2000 IDE
* gRPC
* Know how to use a oscilloscope or logic ananlyzer
* Bash shell scripting
* C\# is an advantage
* Familiar to work in an international environment on cross site projects
* Knowledge of electronics


In addition to the above, you are ambitious, passionate about succeeding together and through the efforts of the team and a total commitment on delivering results.


### **What we offer**



Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting and rewarding, and it is a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunity employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate. Also, Welltec® has a competitive compensation package.

  

### **The process**



If you are interested in the position submit your resume and cover letter online.



Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon if you believe you fit the role.

jobs.title: Senior Graphics Engineer, Shader Systems
jobs.description:
**The opportunity**
-------------------


The Unity Engine is used by millions of creators around the world to build powerful and engaging real\-time experiences. At the heart of this is our flexible and powerful RT3D offering, giving users control from the initial point of content creation down to the final pixels on the target device.

**Hos os er dit job fyldt med udfordringer og ansvar fra start**
----------------------------------------------------------------


Som Software Developer hos os kommer du til at få fingrene i koden på et spændende kundeprojekt fra start. Vi har stor tiltro til dine evner, og vi arbejder ud fra et princip om tillid og fleksibilitet. Vi gør vores ypperste for at imødekomme dine ønsker til projekter og konkrete teknologier, som sikrer din kontinuerlige faglige udvikling.

* Du arbejder med forskellige teknologier på varierende projekter, som matcher din egen motivation for faglig udvikling.
* Du bliver tilknyttet et softwareteknologisk projekt og hjælper med at udvikle løsninger for vores kunder som konsulent.

* Du deltager i faglige oplæg og workshops og bidrager med din nysgerrighed og viden.
* Du tager del i fællesskabet og vores mange sociale aktiviteter og klubber.


Mulighederne er mange – og fair nok, hvis du mister pusten ved at deltage i det hele. Så deltager du bare i det, du synes, er fedest – eller opfinder dit eget event.

#### **Hvem er du?**

* Du har en stor passion for software – måske nørder du egne projekter i fritiden?

* Du elsker måske at se det store billede i en kompleks kodebase?

* Du taler og skriver flydende dansk.

I IT Minds er vi ca. 120 kollegaer i en god blanding af erfarne og nye. Vores kultur er præget af fleksibilitet, tillid og en uformel tone. Fællesskabet er centralt, og vi har mange faglige og sociale arrangementer. Arbejdstiden er fleksibel og kan tilpasses familieliv og fritid.

Kontakt Rune Østergaard, Team Lead, på rune.ostergaard@it\-minds.dk

jobs.title: Software Security Engineer
jobs.description:
**Published**: 2026\-09\-15
**Department**  

IT, Finance \& Compliance
  

Nils Foss Allé 1  

3400 Hillerød  

  

**Country**  

Denmark


At FOSS, we are driven by a strong sense of purpose, and we hope you are too. By 2030, the world population will exceed 9 billion and the middle class will have doubled. This means we will need to be outstandingly smart about our global food production. FOSS is on a mission to enable the sustainable use of the planet’s food resources, and thus to the nutrition of the people of the world. As a global market leader, we contribute through innovative food analysis, which is used to secure food quality, reduce waste, and optimize food production. If that sounds like something you’d like to be a part of, read on!

**What you will be doing**


FOSS builds software in two very different places: the software for and in our analytical instruments, and the IQX cloud platform those instruments are connected to. Both ship to customers, and both are in scope for the EU Cyber Resilience Act and NIS2\. What we do not currently have in FOSS, is someone who will make that software secure in the it is written, rather than how it is tested afterwards.


As our new Software Security Engineer, you will build secure development into how FOSS writes software in IQX and in R\&D. You report to the Head of Information Security, which keeps the role independent of any single delivery organization and you daily work with the IQX department, SRE and, development teams across R\&D.


Key responsibilities include:

* Own our static and composition analysis tooling, including SonarQube quality gates and exceptions. The goal is scanning that teams use, not a gate they work around
* Build secure development practice across IQX and R\&D: coding guidance, code review, dependency and supply\-chain hygiene, and security checks inside the CI/CD pipeline rather than beside it
* Provide security input into architecture and design decisions with the IQX Architect, SRE and R\&D teams, early enough that it changes the design
* Own cloud security posture: Microsoft Defender for Cloud findings, secure score and recommendations, triaged into work that gets done
* Handle customer security questionnaires and assess the third\-party components and vendors we depend on
* Triage vulnerabilities in our software, from scanning, our own penetration testing or outside reports, and drive what matters to closure with the teams that own the code
* Train and coach developers, so secure development becomes something the teams do rather than something one person checks

**What we hope to see you bring**


This role sits between security and engineering and only works if both sides take you seriously. If you are strong on most of it and interested in the rest, apply and tell us which is which.

* A solid grounding in application security \- OWASP, secure SDLC, DevSecOps \- and experience making it work inside real development teams
* A software engineering background. You have shipped production code and can discuss a finding with a developer as a peer. C\#, Python, C, C\+\+ or comparable
* Experience with SAST and SCA tooling such as SonarQube, including quality gate design and the judgement to grant an exception without hollowing out the gate
* Cloud security posture management, ideally Azure and Microsoft Defender for Cloud
* Enough working knowledge of the Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2 and GDPR to turn them into engineering requirements rather than policy text
* Credibility with developers, the ability to influence without direct authority, and the pragmatism to tell apart a control that improves security from one that only produces evidence
* Professional\-level English. Danish is an advantage, not a requirement

**Why choose FOSS?**


You get two quite different software worlds in one role: a cloud platform under active development, and embedded software inside instruments that measure most of the world’s milk and grain. The role is new, the mandate is real, and it reports to the Head of Information Security rather than to a delivery team where security competes with the release date. We support relevant certification and training. The position is full\-time at the FOSS Innovation Centre in Hillerød, with onsite presence and occasional travel.

**We would love to hear from you!**


Submit your application . We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply early. If you have any questions about the role, please contact Christian Ryge, Head of Information Security, at \+45 2091 6692\.


FOSS is committed to maintaining an inclusive and diverse culture. You can help us sustain an unbiased recruitment process by not including photo and age in your application.

**About FOSS**


Today, more than 8 billion people around the world are dependent on nutritional food. Tons of food being produced in a million different ways and under varying conditions, creating challenges all the way from field to fork. One of them, obviously, is the effect it has on climate change.


FOSS helps the world’s 100 biggest food companies, and more than 40,000 others around the world navigate exactly that with intelligent, data\-driven and innovative analytical solutions. We are making sustainability a better business, and we’re doing so as the global market leader in our field – improving food quality, minimizing food waste, ensuring food safety, and securing fair payment.


Join a pioneering and innovative company in the food and agriculture industry. A company on a mission, with offices all around the world and 1,750 talented colleagues across 34 different countries.

Its research spans additive manufacturing, advanced materials, autonomous manufacturing, net\-zero manufacturing, and sustainable value chains. Through collaboration with multinational corporations, local enterprises, and government agencies, SIMTech transforms research outcomes into practical industrial solutions that create real\-world impact.


Job Description
Project Title: Development of Porous Silicon Carbide (SiC) Structures by Direct Ink Writing (DIW)


Project Overview: We are seeking a motivated intern to join an exciting research and development project focused on the fabrication of porous silicon carbide (SiC) components using Direct Ink Writing (DIW), an emerging additive manufacturing technology. The project aims to develop novel SiC formulations and printing processes that enable tunable porosity and tailored properties for thermal management, filtration, energy, and other advanced engineering applications.


This internship offers a unique opportunity to work on cutting\-edge additive manufacturing technology within a research environment, with the potential for successful developments to be translated into industrial applications through collaboration with industry partners.


Key Responsibilities: Assist in the formulation and preparation of SiC\-based DIW inks. Perform rheological characterization and evaluate printability of materials. Conduct 3D printing experiments using DIW equipment. Support drying, debinding, and sintering processes of printed components. Characterize porosity, density, microstructure, and mechanical properties. Analyze experimental data and assist in process optimization. Document research findings and contribute to technical reports and presentations.


Learning Opportunities: Hands\-on experience in additive manufacturing and advanced ceramics. Exposure to materials formulation, rheology, and sintering technologies. Practical experience with microscopy and materials characterization techniques. Understanding of industrial R\&D workflows and technology development. Opportunities to interact with researchers working on advanced manufacturing technologies.


Preferred Qualifications: Undergraduate or postgraduate student in Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related disciplines. Interest in additive manufacturing, advanced materials, and R\&D.


Basic laboratory experience is advantageous but not required. Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

Work on a high\-impact research project with potential industrial applications. Gain exposure to state\-of\-the\-art additive manufacturing technologies. Receive direct mentorship from a Principal Research Engineer with over 30 years of experience in advanced manufacturing research and successful supervision of numerous IA, undergraduate, and postgraduate students, and Contribute to the development of next\-generation ceramic manufacturing solutions. This internship is ideal for students interested in pursuing careers in advanced manufacturing, materials engineering, or research and development.

Strong academic performance is required; candidates with a good GPA will be preferred.


Passion for research, innovation, and advanced manufacturing technologies.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Role**
------------



The Data Engineer will design, develop and support secure, scalable backend applications using .NET Core, C\#, the Microsoft technology stack and AWS cloud services. The role focuses on building reliable APIs, microservices and event\-driven integrations using AWS services such as SNS, SQS, Lambda, EventBridge, API Gateway and managed data services.

* Analyze business and technical requirements for backend, API, cloud and integration solutions
* Design and develop .NET Core applications, REST APIs, microservices and reusable integration components
* Build AWS\-based event\-driven solutions using SNS, SQS, Lambda, EventBridge and API Gateway
* Apply asynchronous messaging, queue\-based processing, retries, dead\-letter queues and idempotency patterns
* Create and maintain technical documentation, API contracts, message schemas and operational support notes
* Collaborate with product, architecture, QA, DevOps/SRE, cloud platform and vendor teams
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Design, develop, test and maintain backend applications using .NET Core, C\#, ASP.NET Core Web APIs, Entity Framework Core and related Microsoft development frameworks.
* Build secure RESTful APIs and integration services with clear contracts, versioning, validation, authentication, authorization and effective error handling.
* Implement event\-driven and asynchronous communication patterns using AWS SNS, SQS, Lambda and EventBridge, including publish/subscribe, queue\-based processing, retries, dead\-letter queues and message tracing.
* Support cloud\-native workloads on AWS using services such as API Gateway, Lambda, EKS/ECS, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, Secrets Manager, IAM and CloudWatch.
* Apply microservices, distributed systems, resiliency, observability, logging and monitoring practices to improve system reliability and supportability.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application, API, database, messaging and cloud infrastructure issues across development, test and production environments.
* Create technical specifications, solution notes, sequence diagrams, API contracts, event/message schemas and operational documentation.
* Support CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, release activities and infrastructure as code using tools such as Git, Bitbucket, Jira, Confluence, Terraform, CloudFormation, Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, QA, DevOps/SRE, cloud platform teams and third\-party vendors to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, documentation and continuous improvement across the development team.
**Requirements**
----------------

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (or similar)
* 6\-8 years of software development experience across design, development, testing, release and production support.
* Strong hands\-on experience with .NET Core / .NET 6\+, C\#, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, asynchronous programming and secure coding practices.
* Experience with the broader .NET and Microsoft stack, including Visual Studio, NuGet, dependency injection, configuration management, authentication/authorization, unit testing and diagnostics.
* Hands\-on AWS development experience with SNS, SQS, Lambda, EventBridge, API Gateway, EKS/ECS, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, Secrets Manager, IAM and CloudWatch.
* Practical knowledge of event\-driven architecture, including publish/subscribe, queue\-based processing, fan\-out, dead\-letter queues, retry policies, idempotency, correlation IDs and eventual consistency.
* Experience with microservices, REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, JSON, XML, API\-led integration and service\-to\-service communication.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL and NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or DynamoDB.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD, Git\-based development, automated builds, deployment pipelines and infrastructure as code using Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Familiarity with engineering and testing tools such as Postman, JMeter, Swagger/OpenAPI, Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket and monitoring/logging platforms.
* Good understanding of unit testing, integration testing, contract testing, performance testing and test automation practices.
* Understanding of application security, secrets management, encryption, least\-privilege access, OWASP principles and secure API design.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across application code, APIs, databases, queues, cloud services and deployment pipelines.
* Good communication, collaboration and documentation skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
* Ability to work effectively in Agile delivery teams and coordinate across product, architecture, engineering, QA, DevOps/SRE and vendor stakeholders.
* Organized, detail\-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

designing, engineering, and maintaining endpoint\-management automation, configuration\-as\-code

capabilities, and CI/CD pipelines across Microsoft Intune and Microsoft 365 environments, while developing

robust C\#/.NET integration services to scale platform reliability and eliminate manual deployment overhead.

related Microsoft technologies.

deployment, drift detection, and rollback.

integration services using C\# and .NET.

configuration.

release controls.

pipelines.

enterprise services.

* Troubleshoot complex pipeline, API, deployment, authentication, and configuration\-management

failures.

* Instrument services and automation to measure health, deployment outcomes, configuration drift, and

operational failures.

* Modernize or retire legacy repositories, pipelines, artifacts, cloud resources, and supporting services.
* Author technical documentation, operational runbooks, architecture diagrams, and support cross\-

training to eliminate single\-person dependencies.

* Partner with endpoint, desktop, security, product, and support teams to define configuration ownership

and engineering standards.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

* Experience building and maintaining production infrastructure automation or platform\-engineering

solutions.

* Experience building CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions or a comparable enterprise pipeline platform.
* Experience with Git, pull requests, branching strategies, peer review, and source\-control governance.

administrative controls.

environments.

* Knowledge of automated testing, change validation, deployment, rollback, and production verification

practices.

* Ability to troubleshoot across application code, automation pipelines, cloud services, identity,

permissions, and endpoint platforms.

* Experience implementing Microsoft 365 Desired State Configuration (M365DSC).
* Hands\-on experience with Entra ID governance, Azure services, ServiceNow workflows, or Power

Automate integrations.

* Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, Azure

Developer Associate, or DevOps Engineer Expert).

(PTO) program that meets or exceeds applicable Washington paid sick leave requirements. Additional benefit

details and eligibility requirements will be provided during the hiring process.
