jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer (Python/Azure/Fabric/Purview)
jobs.description:
##### **Project description**

Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.  

  

Your Skills And Experiences  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.
##### **Responsibilities**


Shape customer's architectural strategy to create a secure, scalable, and compliant cloud environment


Act as a trusted advisor for the customer to ensure alignment with strategic goals, advocate customer's interests when working in a diverse team of various stakeholders, and promote cutting\-edge cloud technologies.


Design and adopt governance automation services by leveraging new technology paradigms (e.g. serverless, containers, microservices) and cloud best practices


Work as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams


Producing technical documentation and architecture decision records.


Implement DevOps practices such as infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployment


Coordination of team resources to solve problems and technical issues


Work in Agile (Scrum, Kanban), defining, estimating, and delivering stories


##### **Skills**

PowerShell,


Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS),


Python,


Microsoft Azure DevOps,


Microsoft Azure Services,


Microsoft Fabric,


Network,


IP Routing,


TCP/IP,


CI/CD


Nice to have


Proven experience of working with MS Fabric,


AI Landing zones,


C\# proficiency, Databricks,


self\-driven/self\-motivated.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.**



At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.  

  

Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

### **Your Impact**



As a senior engineer on the team, you will be intimately involved in architecture decisions that shape this product. You live and breathe cloud services that require high availability and fast, consistent performance.  

  

You operate in an AI\-first engineering environment, where you leverage advanced AI systems to inform design decisions, accelerate development, and improve system reliability. You are expected to drive adoption of AI\-enabled engineering practices across teams, ensuring scalable and efficient development workflows.  

  

You will work closely with product managers and designers to ensure we are building the right solution for our customers, while also mentoring engineers on both system design and AI\-first development practices.


### **What You'll Do**


**Work Location:** This role is based out of our Bucharest office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in\-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in\-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

  

* Lead engineering architecture design reviews, incorporating AI\-driven insights and system modeling
* Set a high technical bar through code and architecture reviews, including evaluation of AI\-generated code and patterns
* Mentor engineers on scalable system design and AI\-first development practices
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted development tools and workflows across the engineering organization
* Work across teams with Product, Design, and Engineering to create integrated solutions
* Improve engineering processes by embedding automation, AI tooling, and intelligent workflows into planning and execution
* Build services that adhere to high standards on availability and latency in a mission\-critical environment
* Leverage AI systems to optimize performance, observability, and operational efficiency

### **What You Bring**


* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* 6\+ years of professional software development experience
* Experience designing and delivering highly\-available, scalable cloud\-based systems
* Backend service experience in multiple managed languages such as Java, Scala, Go, C\#, or similar
* Experience with SQL or NoSQL data stores
* Experience evaluating and integrating AI\-assisted development tools into engineering workflows
* Strong understanding of how AI can be applied to improve developer productivity, system design, and operational efficiency


Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long\-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.



Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


**Important Notes**


*The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.*


*Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.*


*We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.*


*Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well\-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.*


*We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We're committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email* *recruitingops@axon.com.* *Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.*



Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process. All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers. If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not **@axon.com**, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

jobs.title: Edge Services Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **Bouw mee aan de razendsnelle en veilige contentlevering voor de grootste mediagroep van de Benelux**


Bij DPG Media geloven we dat een feilloze gebruikerservaring en topprestaties hand in hand gaan met ijzersterke beveiliging. Als Edge Services Engineer ben je een onmisbare schakel in ons innovatieve Edge Services\-team. Samen verleggen we de grenzen van onze IT\-infrastructuur en zorg jij voor de optimalisatie en beveiliging van webapplicaties die primair op het internet draaien. Bouw samen met ons aan de toekomst van digitale mediadistributie!


Jouw werkveld? De Tech Platforms cluster binnen onze grote IT\-afdeling. Dit betekent dat jouw werk impact heeft op de héle organisatie, over alle landen (NL/BE) en business units heen.

#### **Wat ga je doen?**


Het is het doel van het Edge Services\-team om een gecentraliseerd platform te bouwen en te onderhouden, waarmee onze diverse IT\-teams en business units zelfstandig aan de slag kunnen (self\-service). Jij draagt de verantwoordelijkheid voor het distribueren van petabytes aan digitale media naar onze eindconsumenten. Tegelijkertijd verdedig je onze media\-assets tegen internet kwetsbaarheden zoals DDoS\-aanvallen en andere web attacks (inclusief bot\-management).


Ook AI speelt een rol in jouw dagelijkse werk: je gebruikt AI als assistent om je werk efficiënter te maken, en zorgt er tegelijkertijd voor dat onze media\-assets afgeschermd blijven van ongewenste AI\-exploitatie.


Concreet zien jouw verantwoordelijkheden er zo uit:

* **Beheer en optimalisatie:** Je bent de beheerder van ons Content Delivery Network (Akamai CDN) en de Web Application Firewall (Akamai WAF).
* **DNS \& Domeinnamen:** Je zorgt voor geautomatiseerd en gecentraliseerd beheer van onze publieke DNS en meer dan 10\.000 domeinnamen (\+1\.000 DNS zones).
* **Automatisering \& API's:** Je gebruikt bestaande en creëert nieuwe API's om Edge Services breed toegankelijk en self\-service te maken voor andere teams.
* **Adviseren \& Verbinden:** Je communiceert proactief met applicatieteams (zoals content websites, video streaming en online services) om hen te laten zien hoe ze Edge Services kunnen inzetten om hun productiviteit te verhogen.
* **Operations:** Je pakt operationele taken op zoals rapportages, request handling en incident response, met een scherp oog voor kostenefficiëntie en veiligheid.

#### **Wie ben jij?**


 Jij snapt dat het verenigen van verschillende eisen en tooling in één samenhangend platform de kern is van Edge Services. Om dit complexe, heterogene landschap optimaal te leveren én te beschermen, breng je het volgende mee:

* Kennis van Content Delivery Networks en Web Application Firewalls (bij voorkeur Akamai).
* Diepgaande kennis van domeinnaam\-protocollen en DNS vanuit een operationeel perspectief.
* Kennis van AWS Cloud Infrastructuur vanuit een DevOps\-oogpunt.
* Ervaring met API\-architectuur en Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Ervaring in grote, internationale organisaties en je bent vertrouwd met Scrum/Kanban en Atlassian tooling (Jira/Confluence).
* Je werkt analytisch, nauwkeurig en zelfstandig, maar bent ook sociaal, overtuigend en communicatief sterk.
* Je hebt een hands\-on mentaliteit en bent altijd op zoek naar *business value*.
* Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en/of Engels.

**Nog niet overtuigd?**

* **Jouw speelveld:** De grootste mediagroep van de Benelux! Denk aan HLN.be, deMorgen.be, AD.nl, de Volkskrant, Tweakers.net, NU.nl, RTL.nl, Qmusic, VTM, VTM GO, Streamz, Videoland, Buienradar en nog veel meer...
* **ICT binnen DPG Media?** Dat is een groot, ijzersterk team waarin samenwerken de sleutel tot succes is. Met een échte Agile mindset bouwen we aan compleet nieuwe mediaproducten, redactiesystemen, video broadcasting\-platformen en websites.

  

Bij DPG Media staan we open voor **alle talent** in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt. Wil je meer weten over onze inclusieve werkomgeving, klik dan **hier**!

#### **Wat mag je verwachten van DPG Media**

* Deze opportuniteit biedt je een fantastische job in het toonaangevend Mediabedrijf van België, binnen een moderne en groeiende afdeling waar ieder talent zich thuis voelt;
* We geloven daarnaast in een gezonde werk\-privébalans waarbij we je voldoende zuurstof geven door ons well\-being en flexwerk beleid;
* De strategie van DPG Media focust op de digitale versnelling en hoe we ervoor zorgen dat we als leidend mediabedrijf voorop blijven. Daarvoor zijn ook jouw talenten, kennis en skills cruciaal. Dus geven we je alle kansen om te blijven groeien. Zo houd je grip op je toekomst. Via verschillende opleidingen en de “Academy by DPG Media” neem je ownership over jouw ontplooiing;

**Wat zit er nog in je pakket?**


**Beloning die bij je past:** Krijg een salaris dat net zo indrukwekkend is als je cv en talenten.


**Alles wat je nodig hebt:** We zorgen dat je alles in huis hebt: laptop, telefoon en maaltijdcheques zodat je helemaal los kunt gaan op je werk.


️ **Zorgeloos verzekerd**: Met onze verzekering ben je helemaal gedekt, no worries!

**Flexibiliteit:** Met mogelijkheden voor thuiswerkdagen kies je wat het beste voor jou werkt! Alles om werk en privé in balans te houden.

**Deel in ons succes:** Als DPG Media scoort, scoor jij ook. Extra zakcentjes op basis van onze prestaties. Ka\-ching!

**Slimme mobiliteit:** Of je nu fietst, met het OV komt of parkeert, jij kiest wat het beste werkt.

**Blijf groeien:** Ontdek continu nieuwe hoogtes via de DPG Media Academy. Wie zei dat leren saai moest zijn?

**Tijd voor ontspanning**: Met 32 vakantiedagen kun je je batterij weer helemaal opladen.

**Kantoren vol creativiteit**: Laat je inspireren in onze bruisende hubs in Antwerpen of Vilvoorde.

**Media Kortingen:** Scoor leuke deals op onze media en evenementen. Want wie houdt er niet van een goede deal?

**Top sfeer:** Van spontane feestjes tot teamuitjes, hier voel je je meteen thuis. En ons legendarische personeelsfeest? Daar wil je niets van missen!

#### **Solliciteren, en dan?**


Ben jij een topper in je vakgebied of heb je de ambitie om dat te worden? Fleur je helemaal op in een warme, creatieve en bruisende omgeving waar je constant uitgedaagd wordt? Solliciteer via de onderstaande button en laten we samen bekijken wat we voor elkaar kunnen betekenen. Want jouw talent is welkom bij DPG Media, ongeacht jouw achtergrond en voorkeuren.


Meer weten neem dan contact op met **Toon Hertogs** via toon.hertogs@persgroep.net.

  

\#DPG Media België

**Votre mission se déroule :** Machelen.


#### **Zoom sur la fonction :**


* assurer le rôle de primary maintenance engineer pour des applications de gestion des bagages sur différents sites aéroportuaires internationaux
* analyser et résoudre les incidents de production, notamment les problèmes d’affichage, de tri, de données de vol et de performance des systèmes
* réaliser des analyses de causes racines sur des problèmes logiciels complexes liés aux messages bagages, au contrôle du tri et aux workflows
* rédiger et présenter des rapports de maintenance aux parties prenantes des aéroports
* collaborer avec les techniciens sur site, les équipes IT des aéroports et les fournisseurs d’équipements afin de résoudre les problèmes intersystèmes
* piloter l’intégration technique entre les logiciels EDAS et les systèmes de gestion des bagages de fournisseurs tiers
* développer et maintenir des connecteurs entre les applications BHS et les équipements industriels tels que les trieurs, convoyeurs et scanners
* configurer les paramètres de sécurité, résoudre les problèmes de communication au niveau des protocoles et garantir la fiabilité des flux de données
* configurer et maintenir les systèmes de traçabilité, de tri et de réconciliation des bagages
* concevoir et tester des configurations à haute disponibilité et des mécanismes de redondance
* assurer le support de 2e et 3e ligne pour la suite d’applications BHS EDAS
* travailler avec des message brokers, les standards de messagerie IATA et des pipelines de traitement de données en temps réel
* travailler avec des protocoles de communication industriels tels que OPC UA et les messages IATA 1745 BSM
* maintenir les interfaces de sortation allocation pour le routage des bagages en temps réel
* analyser et résoudre les problèmes liés aux moteurs de workflow, aux intégrations de message brokers et à la logique de tri
* intégrer les systèmes avec les airline departure control systems et les plateformes de réconciliation des bagages
* maintenir la documentation technique, notamment les documents de configuration, les spécifications d’intégration, les guides de dépannage et les runbooks opérationnels
* documenter le comportement des connecteurs, les procédures de déploiement et les configurations de redondance
* contribuer au partage de connaissances et à la base de connaissances interne
* identifier les problèmes récurrents et mettre en place des améliorations durables
* contribuer aux initiatives de stabilisation logicielle du portefeuille applicatif
* participer au développement d’environnements de test et de plateformes virtuelles de simulation aéroportuaire
* contribuer aux activités de refactoring afin d’améliorer la maintenabilité et la qualité du code

#### **Venez comme vous êtes, avec idéalement :**


* bachelier ou master en informatique, software engineering, automatisation industrielle ou dans un domaine technique connexe, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente
* minimum 3 ans d’expérience en software engineering, intégration de systèmes ou support technique dans un environnement industriel, logistique, transport ou de production 24/7
* expérience avec les applications de gestion des bagages, les systèmes de traçabilité, de tri et de réconciliation des bagages
* bonne connaissance d’OPC UA, IATA 1745 BSM, SITA messaging, MQTT, AMQP et des concepts d’intégration de systèmes
* solides compétences en debugging et en analyse de causes racines sur les couches applicatives, bases de données, réseaux et protocoles
* expérience avec C\# (.NET Framework/.NET Core), Python, PowerShell ou Bash
* connaissance de SQL Server, PostgreSQL, des procédures stockées, de l’optimisation des performances des bases de données et des processus de migration de données
* expérience dans l’administration de Windows Server et Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux/CentOS)
* familiarité avec VMware, Hyper\-V, VPN, RDP, SSH et les solutions d’accès à distance sécurisé
* expérience avec Git, GitLab, GitHub, les concepts CI/CD, Docker, Jira et Confluence
* compréhension du dépannage réseau, des firewalls, de TLS/SSL et de la segmentation des réseaux industriels
* connaissance de l’architecture des systèmes de gestion des bagages, des systèmes SAC, du BMR, de l’intégration avec les airline DCS et des standards IATA pour les opérations aéroportuaires
* capacité à produire une documentation technique claire et à communiquer efficacement avec les clients, partenaires et collègues
* organisé et à l’aise avec la gestion d’activités sur plusieurs sites et projets
* approche collaborative tout en étant capable de travailler de manière autonome lorsque nécessaire
* connaissance du français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, constitue un atout pour collaborer avec de nombreuses parties prenantes aéroportuaires

#### **Et si vous deveniez BHS Software Engineer chez Equans ?**


**C’est aussi :**


* un salaire conforme au marché et à votre formation \& expérience
* de belles opportunités de formation et de développement
* une assurance groupe, une assurance hospitalisation
* des écochèques, des chèques\-repas, des frais de représentation, 13ème mois, pécule de vacances
* voiture de société électrique, plan de leasing vélo
* smartphone avec abonnement, intervention internet
* des congés RTT, congés d’ancienneté, télétravail
* des réductions via Benefits@Work (culture, sport, voyages, etc.)
  
**À propos d’Equans Digital Airport Systems (EDAS)**
Equans Digital Airport Systems (EDAS) est l’entité logicielle BHS (Baggage Handling System) d’Equans Belux. Nous concevons, développons, déployons et maintenons des solutions logicielles critiques pour les systèmes de traitement des bagages dans les aéroports à travers le monde, en Europe, en Amérique du Nord, en Afrique et au Moyen\-Orient.
Au sein d’Equans ICT, nous combinons une expertise approfondie de la logistique aéroportuaire avec des pratiques modernes de développement logiciel. Notre équipe de 9 développeurs travaille en étroite collaboration avec les chefs de projet, les support engineers et les techniciens sur site afin de fournir des systèmes fiables et hautement disponibles qui assurent la circulation continue des bagages.
Nous menons actuellement un important programme de transformation axé sur la stabilisation logicielle, l’automatisation CI/CD, le développement de plateformes d’accès à distance et la modernisation des environnements de test. Vous rejoignez une période passionnante de renouvellement technique.

**Software Engineer**
---------------------


Offer ID: 89806
Job: Digital and IT / Software / NetworkEngineer
Contract type: Permanent
Schedule: Full\-Time
Country: Belgium
As a BHS Software Engineer, you take ownership of baggage handling applications, production support, system integration and configuration for international airport installations. You work on mission\-critical airport systems, solve complex operational issues and contribute to the reliability of baggage handling operations while collaborating with airport stakeholders, equipment vendors and international project teams.


At Equans, we believe that diverse talents strengthen our teams. We actively build an inclusive work environment where everyone feels welcome, can be themselves, and we encourage everyone to apply.


**Your work location:** Machelen.


#### **Zoom on the job:**


* act as the primary maintenance engineer for baggage handling applications across international airport sites
* diagnose and resolve production incidents including display issues, sorting problems, flight data discrepancies and system performance issues
* perform root cause analysis on complex software issues related to baggage messaging, sortation control and workflow processing
* prepare and present maintenance reports to airport stakeholders
* collaborate with on\-site technicians, airport IT teams and third\-party equipment suppliers to resolve cross\-system issues
* lead the technical integration between EDAS software and third\-party baggage handling systems
* develop and maintain connectors between BHS applications and industrial equipment such as sorters, conveyors and scanners
* configure security settings, resolve communication protocol issues and ensure reliable production data flows
* configure and maintain baggage tracking, sortation and reconciliation systems
* design and test high\-availability and redundancy configurations
* provide 2nd and 3rd line support across the EDAS BHS application suite
* work with message brokers, IATA messaging standards and real\-time data processing pipelines
* work with industrial communication protocols including OPC UA and IATA 1745 BSM messaging
* maintain sortation allocation interfaces for real\-time baggage routing
* troubleshoot workflow engines, message broker integrations and sortation logic
* integrate systems with airline departure control systems and baggage reconciliation platforms
* maintain technical documentation including configuration documents, integration specifications, troubleshooting guides and operational runbooks
* document connector behaviour, deployment procedures and redundancy configurations
* contribute to knowledge sharing and the internal knowledge base
* identify recurring issues and implement permanent improvements
* contribute to software stabilisation initiatives across the application portfolio
* participate in test environment development and virtual airport test platforms
* contribute to software refactoring activities to improve maintainability and code quality

#### **Come as you are, ideally with:**


* bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, industrial automation or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
* minimum 3 years of experience in software engineering, systems integration or technical support within an industrial, logistics, transport or 24/7 production environment
* experience with baggage handling applications, baggage tracking, sortation and reconciliation systems
* solid knowledge of OPC UA, IATA 1745 BSM, SITA messaging, MQTT, AMQP and system integration concepts
* strong debugging and root cause analysis skills across application, database, network and protocol layers
* experience with C\# (.NET Framework/.NET Core), Python, PowerShell or Bash
* knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, stored procedures, database performance tuning and data migration processes
* experience with Windows Server and Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux/CentOS) administration
* familiarity with VMware, Hyper‑V, VPN, RDP, SSH and secure remote connectivity
* experience with Git, GitLab, GitHub, CI/CD concepts, Docker, Jira and Confluence
* understanding of network troubleshooting, firewalls, TLS/SSL and industrial network segmentation
* knowledge of baggage handling architecture, SAC systems, BMR, airline DCS integration and IATA airport operations standards
* able to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with customers, partners and colleagues
* organised and comfortable managing activities across multiple sites and projects
* collaborative approach with the ability to work independently when required
* knowledge of French (both written and spoken — valuable for communication with many airport stakeholders)

#### **What if you became BHS Software Engineer at Equans?**


**For you this means:**


* a market rate salary in line with your education and experience
* interesting training and career opportunities
* group insurance, hospitalization insurance
* eco vouchers, meal vouchers, representation allowance, 13th month, holiday pay
* electrical lease car, bicycle lease plan
* smartphone with subscription, internet fee
* additional paid leave, seniority leave, homeworking
* discounts through Benefits@Work (culture, sports, travel, and more)
  

**About Equans Digital Airport Systems (EDAS)**


Equans Digital Airport Systems (EDAS) is the BHS (Baggage Handling System) software unit within Equans Belux. We design, develop, deploy, and maintain mission\-critical software solutions for airport baggage handling systems worldwide — serving airports across Europe, North America, Africa, and the Middle East.


As part of Equans ICT, we combine deep domain expertise in airport logistics with modern software engineering practices. Our team of 9 developers works closely with project managers, support engineers, and on\-site technicians to deliver reliable, high\-availability systems that keep baggage flowing 24/7\.


We are currently undertaking a significant transformation program focused on software stabilization, CI/CD automation, remote access platform development, and test environment modernization — you will be joining at an exciting time of technical renewal.

jobs.title: Engineer Mechanics
jobs.description:
At ScioTeq, we develop advanced visualization solutions in a dynamic **high\-tech environment** for the **Avionics**, **Air Traffic Control** and **Defense** **\& Security** markets. To support the continued growth of our Defense activities, we are looking for a **Mechanical Engineer** to strengthen our team in **Kortrijk, Belgium**.


Are you passionate about mechanical design and high\-tech product development? Do you enjoy turning ideas and technical requirements into practical, reliable solutions?


As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the development of advanced Defense display and console solutions. Working in a multidisciplinary team, you will be responsible for the mechanical design of products from concept to implementation. You will join a highly experienced team where collaboration, knowledge sharing and long\-term commitment are key.

**Your responsibilities**

* You develop and maintain mechanical concepts and CAD designs using **Creo Parametric**.
* You translate customer and product requirements into practical, reliable and cost\-effective solutions.
* You work closely with electronics engineers, production teams, project managers and suppliers throughout the development process.
* You apply your knowledge of materials, manufacturing methods and mechanical engineering principles to create robust designs.
* You support the integration of existing technologies and adapt proven concepts to new applications.
* You contribute to solving technical challenges related to design, assembly, manufacturability and product quality.
* You support prototype development and testing activities.
* You ensure that your designs meet quality standards, technical requirements and customer expectations.

 **Your profile**

* You hold a Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electromechanics, Industrial Design Engineering or equivalent through experience.
* You have experience in mechanical design and product development.
* You have experience with parametric CAD software, preferably Creo Parametric 8\.0 or higher.
* You have a good understanding of manufacturing processes, machining techniques and design for manufacturability.
* Knowledge of thermal (FloEFD) and structural (Creo Simulate) simulations is considered a strong asset.
* Experience with Windchill or similar PLM systems is a plus.
* You are analytical and solution\-oriented.
* You take initiative and work proactively.
* You can work independently while being a strong team player.
* You enjoy working in a collaborative and multidisciplinary environment.
* You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of Dutch is a strong plus.
* You recognize yourself in our company values: Customer Focus, Teamwork, Trust \& Respect and Ethical Behaviour.

**Offer**


ScioTeq is a growing international environment where innovation is key and where motivated colleagues work together on technologies that make a difference.


Our headquarters in Kortrijk are easily accessible by car, bike and public transport.


We offer a competitive salary, complemented by extra\-legal benefits:

* Meal vouchers of €9
* Internet allowance of €60 net
* Yearly bonus
* Group insurance
* Medical insurance
* Flexible salary plan with possibilities for a lease car, electric bicycle, tablet, etc.


In addition, we invest in personal growth by offering various training opportunities throughout the year ('Everyone Learns' program, Mtech\+ training courses, IT Awareness training, Viva Learning, on the job training \& much more).


Furthermore, we value a healthy work\-life balance and promote this by offering flexible working hours, possibility to work from home and 32 vacation days.


 If you join the ScioTeq family, you can also attend various events and activities (like for example a Company Celebration, Out of office party, Quizzes, buddy walks, …) that enhance the team spirit.

We are looking for a **Senior ASP.NET Developer** with proven experience in developing web applications and backend services using **C\# and ASP.NET Core**.


The ideal candidate has a strong background in software design, with a solid understanding and practical application of **SOLID principles**, key **Design Patterns**, and modern software architectures.


Experience in building distributed systems and implementing asynchronous communication using **NServiceBus** and **RabbitMQ** is also required.

### **Required Technical Skills**

#### **Technologies**

* C\#
* ASP.NET Core
* .NET 8, 9, or 10
* Entity Framework Core
* SQL Server
* REST APIs
* Git
* Unit Testing (xUnit, NUnit)

#### **Software Development Principles**

* SOLID
* Clean Code

#### **Design Patterns**

* Repository Pattern
* Unit of Work
* Factory Pattern
* Strategy Pattern
* Builder Pattern
* Mediator Pattern
* CQRS
* Repository

#### **Architectures and Design Approaches**

* Clean Architecture
* Domain\-Driven Design (DDD)
* Event\-Driven Architectures
* Distributed Systems
* Asynchronous Service Communication

### **Preferred Skills**

* NServiceBus
* RabbitMQ
* Queue and Message Management
* Message Processing Error Handling
* Retry Mechanisms and Dead Letter Queues
* Consumer Idempotency
* Asynchronous Events and Commands
* Microsoft Azure

### **Responsibilities**

* Analyze functional and technical requirements.
* Design robust and scalable software solutions.
* Develop web applications and REST APIs using ASP.NET Core.
* Apply SOLID principles and Design Patterns effectively.
* Implement asynchronous processes using NServiceBus and RabbitMQ.
* Design components following Clean Architecture principles.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, Project Managers, and other developers.
* Ensure software quality through unit testing, code reviews, and development best practices.

**Du brauchst kein Vorwissen \- nur Interesse am Programmieren, Freude am Tüfteln und Motivation, gemeinsam im Team etwas zu bewegen.**  

  

**Start am 1\. September 2027 – bewirb dich jetzt!**


Entwicklung / Software / IT
 Lehrlinge/Azubis
Wels, Österreich

Talent Acquisition Manager
\+43 50 486 4381

* Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwickelst du Softwarelösungen, die von Kund:innen im In\- und Ausland täglich genutzt werden.

* Du hast Lust, Programmieren wirklich zu lernen und möchtest verstehen, wie Software funktioniert.
* Logisches Denken fällt dir leicht und bei kniffligen Problemen gibst du nicht gleich auf, sondern freust dich, wenn du die Lösung findest.
* Vorkenntnisse sind kein Muss. Viel wichtiger sind Neugier, Motivation und die Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen.
* Teamarbeit macht dir Spaß, du bist verlässlich und bringst einen positiven Pflichtschulabschluss mit.

* Eine Ausbildung, in der du von Anfang an mitmachen und Verantwortung übernehmen kannst.
* Ausbildner:innen, die sich Zeit für dich nehmen, dich unterstützen und dein Potenzial fördern.
* Lehre mit Matura, Fachkurse sowie zahlreiche Trainings und Events für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung.

Mitarbeiterevents

jobs.title: Platform Operations Engineer (Linux & DevOps)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a **Platform Operations Engineer (Linux \& DevOps)** to join our team in a remote working environment. This role focuses on supporting and modernizing critical platforms, ensuring operational stability and reliability across Linux environments, containerized workloads and hybrid cloud infrastructure. You will work closely with engineering teams on automation, observability and deployment initiatives.


EPAM NEORIS is a digital accelerator that supports some of the world’s leading companies in addressing business challenges and advancing their technology evolution, combining global engineering excellence with regional expertise and local proximity.  

With operations across 11 countries in Ibero\-America and more than 4,000 professionals in the region, we foster a diverse and inclusive culture focused on collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation.  

As part of EPAM, a global network of more than 60,000 professionals across 55\+ countries, we help organizations scale, modernize, and accelerate their digital capabilities through Cloud, Data \& Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Intelligent Automation, Strategic Consulting, and Software Engineering.  

At EPAM NEORIS, we believe growth is also driven by people. That is why we promote an environment where every professional can grow, contribute new ideas, and participate in projects with regional and global impact.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage Linux environments and ensure platform stability and performance
* Support and troubleshoot containerized workloads running on Docker and Podman
* Develop and maintain Bash automation to improve operational efficiency
* Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation processes
* Maintain monitoring, logging, alerting and observability solutions across the platform
* Collaborate with developers, architects and infrastructure teams on deployments, incident resolution and modernization initiatives

**Requirements**

* Strong Linux administration experience
* Hands\-on experience with container technologies such as Docker and Podman
* Advanced Bash scripting expertise with the ability to read, analyze and develop complex scripts
* Experience working with AWS services and hybrid deployments across private and public cloud environments
* Basic networking knowledge, including troubleshooting network interfaces, routing and performance issues
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, TeamCity, Ansible or equivalent solutions
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo or equivalent tools
* Critical thinking and strong problem\-solving skills
* Delivery\-focused mindset with the ability to work in fast\-paced environments
* English level C1 is mandatory

**Nice to have**

* Development experience with C\# or Java
* Understanding of .NET or JVM runtimes and application management
* Knowledge of Linux CPU and memory management
* Experience migrating large\-scale legacy systems
* Experience designing and building complex deployment pipelines
* Experience managing self\-hosted tools and platforms

**We offer**

* Permanent contract with a competitive salary
* Flexible working model with remote work options
* Personalized career plan and continuous learning (certifications, English training, etc.)
* Participation in stable projects with a strong technical focus
* Flexible working hours and a strong focus on work–life balance
* Benefits package tailored to your needs


EPAM is a leading digital transformation services and product engineering company with 61,700\+ EPAMers in 55\+ countries and regions. Since 1993, our multidisciplinary teams have been helping make the future real for our clients and communities around the world. In 2018, we opened an office in Spain that quickly grew to over 1,450 EPAMers distributed between the offices in Málaga, Madrid and Cáceres as well as remotely across the country. Here you will collaborate with multinational teams, contribute to numerous innovative projects, and have an opportunity to learn and grow continuously.




* **Why Join EPAM**
* **WORK AND LIFE BALANCE.** Enjoy more of your personal time with flexible work options, 24 working days of annual leave and paid time off for numerous public holidays.
* **CONTINUOUS LEARNING CULTURE.** Craft your personal Career Development Plan to align with your learning objectives. Take advantage of internal training, mentorship, sponsored certifications and LinkedIn courses.
* **CLEAR AND DIFFERENT CAREER PATHS.** Grow in engineering or managerial direction to become a People Manager, in\-depth technical specialist, Solution Architect, or Project/Delivery Manager.
* **STRONG PROFESSIONAL COMMUNITY.** Join a global EPAM community of highly skilled experts and connect with them to solve challenges, exchange ideas, share expertise and make friends.

Backend Developer
  
  

Are you ready to shape the future of access systems? At SKIDATA, we're leaders in cutting\-edge access solutions, and we're looking for a passionate Software Engineer to join our dynamic Global Customized Solutions (GCS) team. If you thrive on solving complex integration challenges, love crafting tailored solutions, and are eager to support customers and partners worldwide, this is your chance to make a real impact.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
  

**Design and Deliver Custom Solutions:** Build tailored software integrations that connect third\-party systems with SKIDATA products to meet specific customer needs.
  
**Support Global Integration Projects:** Provide integration support for public interfaces and guide third\-party partners in connecting with SKIDATA systems.

What You Bring
  
  

University degree in Computer Science or equivalent qualification

Strong experience in C\# / .NET (.NET 8 or later, ASP.NET Core)

Experience with relational and NoSQL databases
  
Experience with web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript) and modern frameworks (Angular, React)
  
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (e.g. Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins)
  
Experience with API management and design (REST, API gateways)
  
Understanding of secure coding practices and software supply\-chain security
  
Experience working effectively in a globally distributed team, with strong remote collaboration and documentation habits
  
Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot)
  
Fluent English (written and spoken); German or another regional language is a plus given our global team setup
  
A self\-organized, analytical team player who thrives in a multicultural, collaborative environment
  
  

What You Can Expect
  
  

**Flexible Hybrid Work Model:** Achieve a better work\-life balance with our adaptable hybrid working options.
  
**Meal Allowance:** Benefit from a digital meal designed to suit your preferences.
  
**Job Bike Leasing Program:** Participate in our bike leasing program to promote a healthier and more active lifestyle.
  
**Transport Subsidy:** Receive financial support for your Job Ticket to help with your daily travel costs.
  
**Extra Vacation Days:** Take advantage of an optional additional week of vacation to recharge.
  
**Support Sustainability:** Access electric vehicle charging stations in our parking area to support eco\-friendly commuting.
  
**Global Collaboration:** Work alongside an international team of specialists, sharing knowledge and insights from diverse backgrounds.
  
**Professional Growth Opportunities:** Discover excellent chances for career development and skill enhancement.
  
  

Ready to make an impact? Apply today and be a part of SKIDATA's innovative journey!
  
  

We offer a competitive salary based on your qualifications and professional experience. The minimum salary for this position according to the collective agreement is EUR 2,535\.00 gross per month on a full\-time basis. Of course, your actual salary will be adjusted in line with the market based on your qualifications.
  
  

**Location:** Hybrid within Europe
  
  

Your Personal Contact
  
  

Anja Effenberger – Senior HR Business Partner
  
  

Innovative solutions at the cutting edge, a dynamic and forward\-thinking work environment, and diverse opportunities – welcome to the world of SKIDATA. Join our strong, international team now and help shape the future of modern access solutions with your creativity and expertise. When you join our SKIDATA team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 62,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (AWS)
jobs.description:
Thousands of hotels, resorts, and casinos around the world depend on Duetto's platform to run their revenue strategy — and you'll be one of the people making sure it never lets them down. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll own the infrastructure that powers our global SaaS platform: designing for scale, building for reliability, and driving the kind of security\-first culture that keeps us ahead of the curve. If you thrive in complex cloud environments, love solving hard problems, and want your work to have real, tangible impact — this is the role.


**What makes us different?**



Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue \& Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability.



Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the \#1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the \#1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025\. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI — and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.


**What you'll be doing**


* Design and implement robust, scalable AWS infrastructure — supporting key system migrations, platform growth, and the reliability our customers depend on.
* Own the reliability, performance, and security of our production environment: high uptime, rapid incident resolution, and proactive capacity planning.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and infrastructure\-as\-code using Terraform, Terragrunt, and Chef.
* Monitor system health using enterprise observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog), defining metrics and response playbooks that get ahead of incidents before they happen.
* Lead security\-first practices across the infrastructure estate — proactively addressing vulnerabilities and driving SOC 2 compliance.
* Partner with engineering teams to integrate operational requirements into the development lifecycle and align on architecture decisions.
* Champion AI adoption within DevOps and SRE workflows, evaluating tooling that increases team velocity and reduces toil.
* Respond to on\-call incidents with urgency — troubleshoot complex issues, lead detailed root cause analyses, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence.


**What we're looking for**


**You may be a great fit if you have:**


* 5\+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role.
* Hands\-on AWS experience across IAM, VPC, EC2, ELB, RDS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail — including multi\-account management and SSO.
* Proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure\-as\-code, plus experience with configuration management tools like Chef or Ansible.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling including GitHub, GitHub Actions, JFrog Artifactory, and Jenkins, with familiarity with GitOps methodologies.
* Experience with container and orchestration technologies — Docker, ECS, or EKS.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise monitoring platforms — Prometheus, Grafana, or DataDog.
* Solid troubleshooting skills and a track record of leading root cause analyses and implementing durable fixes.
* Proficiency reading Java, Ruby, Bash/Zsh, HCL, Python, and JavaScript.
* Experience with SOC 2 compliance and security\-first infrastructure practices.
* Comfort with a weekly on\-call rotation.


**Strong candidates may also have:**


* Experience migrating workloads from on\-prem or colocation environments to AWS.
* Familiarity with Windows Server, SQL Server, IIS, and .NET environments.
* Experience administering and synchronising MongoDB replica sets.
* Knowledge of ISO 27001, Layer 7 load balancing, or Terragrunt.
* Background in hospitality technology.
* A degree in Computer Science or a related field — or equivalent experience.


**Why Duetto?**


* **Infrastructure that matters —** your work directly underpins a platform that hotel operators around the world rely on every day. The stakes are real, and so is the satisfaction.
* **AI is how we work —** we're not just talking about AI adoption; we're actively investing in it across every function, including DevOps. You'll have space to evaluate and implement tooling that makes a genuine difference.
* **A team that moves fast —** you'll report into the Senior DevOps Manager and work alongside engineers who are serious about craft, reliability, and continuous improvement.
* **Growth with purpose —** backed by GrowthCurve Capital, we're scaling our platform and our team. There's a lot being built here, and senior engineers have real influence over how it's done.
* **Come as you are —** we're a diverse, distributed team that values different perspectives and builds inclusively.


**The details**


**Location:**Croatia


**Work model:**Remote


**Reports to:**Senior DevOps Manager

  


*Duetto is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*


**Sound like you?**



We'd love to hear from you — even if you don't tick every box. Diverse perspectives and non\-traditional paths make our team stronger. Apply and let's talk.

  



\#LI\-REMOTE

Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data \& AI, Communication, and Workspace.
  

  

Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision\-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group.
### **Your Profile**


* Platform Engineering" Vision:
* Investigates pain points across development teams and delivers solutions that provide real value.
* Facilitates "Self\-service" capabilities by automating processes and providing flawless documentation.
* Translates business needs (support, experimentation, configuration) into scalable, reliable frontend and backend architecture decisions, taking into account the overall impact.
* "Developer First" Mindset \& Sensitivity to Developer Experience (DevEx):
* Understands that their code serves not only the end user, but dozens of developers across other squads. Listens, understands, discusses, and prioritizes the needs of other developers within the context and status of the products.
* Designs APIs, boilerplates, and technical solutions focused on reducing friction, abstracting technical complexity, and enabling other teams to be as autonomous as possible.
* "Hands\-On" Profile \& Pragmatism:
* Highly practical approach focused on delivering value. Enjoys writing frontend, backend, and infrastructure code, resolving real blockages, and avoiding complex abstractions or unnecessary over\-engineering.
* Excellent Communication \& Evangelization Skills:
* Ability to communicate architectural decisions, deliver internal workshops, and write flawless integration guides.
* Autonomy \& Proactivity:
* Ability to detect performance bottlenecks in tooling or developer workflows, proposing and implementing quick wins without requiring micromanagement.
### **Your Skills**


* Backend \& BFF (Backend\-for\-Frontend):
* Backend Ecosystem: Advanced domain in developing robust and scalable services using .NET Core / C\# and Node.js (NestJS / Express).
* API Design \& Resilience: Design and consumption of REST APIs, applying resilience patterns (circuit breakers, retries, rate limiting).
* Modern Frontend \& Micro\-Frontends (MFE) Architecture:
* Core Frameworks: Expert domain in React / TypeScript or Next.js for developing complex, modular, high\-performance interfaces.
* Module Federation: Hands\-on experience with Webpack / Vite Module Federation for runtime dynamic loading of MFEs, managing shared scopes, and error isolation (Error Boundaries).
* Authentication \& State: Management of OIDC / OAuth2 identity and authentication flows, along with global/context state management.
* Containers \& Orchestration:
* Docker: Demonstrable experience in managing, optimizing images (multi\-stage builds), and securing Docker containers.
* Kubernetes (K8s): Experience in orchestrating, deploying, and administering applications in K8s clusters (deployments, services, ingresses, configmaps).
* CI/CD, GitOps \& Quality:
* CI Pipelines: Creation and management of Continuous Integration pipelines for build automation, executing unit/integration tests, static code analysis, and pushing images to registries (Harbor).
* GitOps \& CD: Practical experience in GitOps workflows and Continuous Deployment, with a preference for ArgoCD.
* Testing: Experience in automated testing and a shift\-left quality culture.
* Nice\-to\-Have:
* AI\-Assisted Development \& Agents: Experience or strong interest in AI\-powered development workflows (Gemini, Copilot, Cursor, etc.), as well as integrating or developing AI agents and conversational interfaces to automate development or platform tasks.
* Cloud Computing (Multicloud \& GCP): Experience in Multicloud environments. Practical knowledge and experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Cloud Run, GKE, IAM, Secret Manager) or involvement in cross\-cloud migration projects from Azure to GCP.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform: Knowledge or experience in provisioning and automating cloud resources using Terraform, facilitating the creation of scalable, replicable environments integrated into platform deployment workflows.
* Observability: Knowledge of telemetry and traceability standards such as OpenTelemetry, as well as experience implementing and querying observability dashboards in the Grafana Stack (Prometheus/Mimir, Loki, Tempo, K6\).
* Feature Flags: Management of progressive deployment workflows using Feature Flags (Unleash).
* Tooling \& Internal Developer Portals: Familiarity with the Backstage ecosystem (creation of Software Templates/Boilerplates and TechDocs).

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Materialise Medical, we believe that better healthcare starts with solutions designed around the individual patient. If you’re passionate about bringing personalized care to every patient, you’ll love being a part of this team. Through the technology we develop, researchers, engineers, and clinicians are revolutionizing personalized treatment — helping improve and save lives daily.  



  

Do you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges rather than building standard web pages? Would you like your code to help surgeons plan life‑changing surgeries and improve patients’ lives worldwide? At Materialise Medical, we develop advanced 3D medical planning tools that empower clinicians and researchers to create patient‑specific treatments. We are now looking for a front‑end software engineer who is passionate about well‑structured, object‑oriented code and clean architecture.


**What you will do**
--------------------

* Design and implement complex front\-end modules with a strong focus on application logic, 3D visualization, and computational workflows, not just UI
* Work in a modern TypeScript\-based stack using object\-oriented principles and design patterns
* Collaborate closely with architects, product managers, and fellow engineers to turn product requirements into robust, maintainable code
* Write clean, testable, and reusable components with a strong focus on quality (unit tests, TDD mindset)
Contribute to internal tools that improve engineering quality and developer experience  
* 

**Your profile**
----------------

* You have strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoy solving algorithmic or mathematical problems
* You are fluent in OOP concepts and design patterns (e.g., Factory, Strategy, etc.)
* You understand and follow SOLID principles
* You have strong proficiency in TypeScript, with familiarity in other object\-oriented languages (e.g., C\#, Java) as a nice\-to\-have
* 4\+ years of professional experience in designing and delivering production\-ready applications
Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset  
* 

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with 3D rendering, computational geometry, or scientific visualization
Familiarity with vertex/matrix algebra or simulation\-type logic  
* 

  

**What’s waiting for you**

**Work that matters**  

The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day.


At Materialise, we expect you to think about the customer, not just the task. You push for better solutions and care about the difference your work makes.  



**A people\-centered space**  

When you join Materialise, you join a group of colleagues invested in you, not just your work. From your own team to a department across the world, you’ll find a sense of belonging with people who help without being asked, challenge you, and have your back.


At the same time, we expect you to invest in the people around you — not just your own work — to make the group stronger than the sum of its parts.  



**An environment of trust**  

As a company of innovators, we know how crucial autonomy is in your work. When we hire you, we trust in your expertise, giving you space to organize your tasks, work flexibly, and make your own calls.


At Materialise, we expect you to deliver on that trust and keep your commitments.  



**A career ready to build**  

When you see opportunities for your career to grow at Materialise, we encourage you to go for them. People shape a fulfilling career at their own pace here.


At Materialise, we expect you to take initiative in your own development. Don’t wait for someone else to plan your career. Step into the space and make it count.  



  

Make a difference together with the Medical team.

jobs.title: Platform Developer
jobs.description:
**Platform Developer (Híbrido)**

Estamos a recrutar um(a) **Platform Developer** (3 a 5 anos de experiência) para integrar uma equipa de engenharia focada no desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e na automação de processos de entrega.

Procuramos um perfil híbrido que combine competências sólidas de desenvolvimento *backend* em **.NET e/ou Node.js** com uma mentalidade **DevOps**, assumindo a responsabilidade pela construção de APIs, automação de fluxos com **n8n**, pipelines de CI/CD e garantia de estabilidade em ambiente de produção.

**O que vais fazer:**

* **Desenvolvimento \& Integração:** Desenvolver e manter aplicações em .NET e/ou Node.js, concebendo APIs REST e integrações entre sistemas internos e externos.
* **Automação de Fluxos:** Criar e otimizar fluxos de automação de processos e integração utilizando **n8n**.
* **Operações \& CI/CD:** Gerir bases de dados relacionais (SQL), construir e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub, GitLab ou Azure DevOps) e operar em ambientes contentorizados com **Docker**.
* **Qualidade \& Resolução de Incidentes:** Garantir a qualidade das soluções através de testes automatizados, participando em *code reviews* e no suporte a incidentes em produção.

**O perfil que procuramos:**

* **Experiência Consolidada:** 3 a 5 anos de experiência prática em desenvolvimento de software e/ou engenharia DevOps.

jobs.title: Intern - Building Performance Engineering
jobs.description:
**Join our Middle East Buildings Environment team as a Building Performance Engineering Intern and gain practical experience in sustainable design, energy efficiency, and building performance.**

 **Here at Buro Happold, expect the exceptional.**


From the projects you will work on to the clients we work with. From career\-defining opportunities to an inclusive and diverse practice where we all contribute to a more equitable world. From our reputation to our relationships. Wherever your Buro Happold career takes you, it’ll be anything but ordinary.

 **Your next role**


Buro Happold has a clear strategic plan, strong learning culture and entrepreneurial mindset that will allow you to thrive.


You’ll be part of something bigger than us all where sustainability, equity, social and performance outcomes matter. All of Buro Happold is committed to doing the right thing, even when that’s the hardest thing. This is a genuine opportunity to make impact \- and leave real legacy.

 **Your key duties**


We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic intern who is interested in building performance engineering and sustainable, net\-zero carbon design. This internship offers an opportunity to develop practical knowledge of how buildings can be designed and operated to improve energy efficiency, occupant comfort, health, and well\-being.


Working under the guidance of senior engineers and sustainability specialists, you will support the delivery of low\-carbon building services and environmental design solutions. You will gain exposure to energy modelling, building simulation, sustainable design standards, and building\-performance analysis.

* Assisting with energy and carbon modelling using tools such as IES\-VE.
* Supporting thermal comfort assessments and façade optimisation studies.
* Helping analyse daylight, natural ventilation, passive cooling, and mixed\-mode ventilation strategies.
* Assisting with sustainability assessments against frameworks such as LEED, WELL, Mostadam, Estidama, and Passivhaus.
* Supporting post\-occupancy evaluations, operational energy modelling, energy audits, and building\-performance reviews.
* Conducting research on sustainable building technologies, climate resilience, energy data analytics, and net\-zero carbon strategies.
* Preparing technical calculations, presentations, reports, and project documentation under supervision.
* Collaborating with multidisciplinary project teams, including building\-services engineers, architects, sustainability consultants, and project managers.
* Developing awareness of workplace and site Health and Safety requirements.

 **Your skills and experience**


We are looking for a current student or recent graduate in one of the following disciplines:

* Building Services or MEP Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Engineering Design or Engineering Science, Physics, Sustainability, or a related discipline.
* A genuine interest in building performance, sustainability, energy efficiency, and net\-zero carbon design.
* Basic understanding of building services, energy systems, HVAC principles, or environmental design.
* Interest in energy modelling, building simulation, and data\-led design decisions.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with an eagerness to learn new software and technical methods.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative team.
* A positive, proactive, and professional approach to learning and contributing to project work.
* Awareness of the importance of Health and Safety in an office and construction\-site environment.

**Preferred Skills:**


The following are desirable but not essential. Training and support will be provided for the right candidate:

* Basic familiarity with IES\-VE or other building\-performance simulation tools.
* Exposure to Rhino, Grasshopper, or parametric modelling tools.
* Awareness of sustainability certification systems such as LEED, WELL, Mostadam, Estidama, or Passivhaus.
* Basic knowledge of energy\-efficiency standards and guidance, such as ASHRAE 90\.1, CIBSE TM54, NABERS\-UK, or ISO 50001\.
* Interest in HVAC controls, energy metering, building\-management systems, and operational energy performance.
* Interest in coding, data analytics, machine learning, or automation for sustainable building design.
* Previous university projects, coursework, or research relating to environmental design, energy, carbon, or building performance.

 **What we offer you**

* Bring your knowledge and expertise to one of the world’s most respected consultancies.
* Hybrid working arrangements
* Attractive salary and benefits package
* A strong commitment to your continuous development. Whatever stage in your career, we have a learning and development programme that will enable and empower you
* Entitlement to two memberships to professional bodies or subscriptions
* An international culture that wherever your career takes you at Buro Happold, you won’t be far from the exceptional.

 **At Buro Happold, everyone else’s extraordinary is just our everyday. Apply today and be a part of our legacy.**

 **A place for everyone**


Buro Happold values individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of the way you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.


Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.


We are working to change the lack of representation of marginalised groups in the built environment and are particularly keen to hear from anyone who feels they are underrepresented in the industry. We have much to learn from one another. Embracing difference allows us to develop the most innovative and elegant solutions.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description:
#### **Your mission**


NanoTemper makes software that runs scientific measurement instruments — used by researchers and biopharma teams to make faster, more confident decisions. The software matters: it sits between precise hardware and the scientists trying to understand complex biology.  

  

**You're role:**  

You will own product features end\-to\-end: from understanding the requirement, through implementation and testing, to release and maintenance. The current product landscape includes C\#/.NET, TypeScript, React, and Python. C\#/.NET is an important part of the existing software, while our technology choices continue to evolve with the needs of our products.  

  

**You may work across several types of software, including:**

* Control and analysis software for scientific instruments.
* Instrument backends that support measurement workflows and interact with the devices.
* Web application components that help users access and work with instrument data.


You will maintain, develop, and take ownership of software in these areas, depending on the product and your experience. You will also work at the boundary between software and hardware — collaborating with embedded engineers where the application talks directly to measurement instruments.  

This is a product engineering role. You will be writing code, reviewing it, fixing things that break in production, and improving the pipelines that ship the product.#### **Your expertise**


Required qualifications:

  

* Proven track record using C\# and .NET
* Experience with Git
* Professional experience shipping and maintaining production software, including ownership of software throughout its lifecycle
* Experience with build pipelines and release processes
* In\-depth experience in automated testing


Preferred qualifications:  

* Proficiency in TypeScript and React
* Familiarity with WPF
* Working knowledge of Python
* Hands\-on involvement in hardware or instrument integration
* A track record of developing software that interfaces with hardware or measurement devices
* Background in scientific, laboratory, or instrumentation software

#### **Why us?**

 **Who are you joining?**  

A team of 8 engineers and 1 product owner. The team has strong engineering foundations and doesn't need to relitigate architecture every sprint — you will find colleagues who want to ship good software and value a teammate who does the same. When we tackle something new, the architecture conversation is open to everyone.  

You will work closely with scientists, hardware engineers, and product managers, which means translating between technical and non\-technical perspectives is a regular part of the job.  

We work in the heart of Munich with excellent public transportation access. We work in a flexible hybrid model. We value regular in\-person collaboration, while offering the flexibility to work remotely when it makes sense.

#### **About us**


Our vision at NanoTemper is to help create a world where every disease is treatable. What drives us is partnering with scientists to ‘make a difference’ in the world.  

With our biophysical instruments we want to push the limits of what is possible for scientific researchers.  

The goals are big and audacious. Hence, it requires very innovative ways and a strong team to get there.  

  

Even if we are an expanding global company with more than 200 employees the heart of NanoTemper beats in Munich. This is where our story began and every day we work as one team to make our devices even better.  

  

Our doors are open for talented people excited about the future of scientific research and our vision.  

Do you want to make a difference with your daily work and become part of our mission? We are looking forward to get to know you.  

  

**But why not let your new colleagues tell you personally what it's like to be part of NanoTemper?**

new_jobs.description:
**Job Title**

Staff Engineer – senior individual contributor (no line management)

**Company**

Landmark Systems Ltd

**Location**

Pulborough, West Sussex/(Hybrid \- 2\-3 days on\-site

**Reports To**

Chief Technology Officer

**Salary**

Dependent on experience, circa £65\-£75K

**About Landmark Systems**

Landmark Systems has been providing specialist accounting and business management software to UK farmers for over 39 years. Our KEYPrime desktop software is trusted by thousands of farms across the country. We’re rebuilding years of hard\-won agricultural domain knowledge as a modern, cloud\-native SaaS product, and we’re looking for a Staff Engineer to help us get the big technical decisions right.

**The Opportunity**

Our next\-generation product is cloud\-native, not cloud\-ported. That means genuinely interesting problems, not a lift\-and\-shift:

· **Multi\-tenancy done properly** — from single farms to multi\-entity groups, accountancy practices and resellers. How we model tenants, organisations and licenses is a live architectural question, and you’d help answer it.

· **A model\-driven platform** — much of the product is generated from a declarative metadata layer that produces both the .NET back end and the Vue front end. Knowing when to work with that grain and when to build a bespoke escape hatch is a real craft.

· **AI as a first\-class capability** — our platform ships with semantic search, retrieval and agent tooling built in. We expect our engineers to build with AI, and to build AI\-backed features into the product itself.

· **A long, deliberate migration** — moving a loyal, established customer base from a mature desktop product to the cloud, without breaking the trust that took 25 years to earn.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own the hard technical decisions end to end — multi\-tenancy, data modelling, platform trade\-offs.

· Set the technical direction on the problems that matter most and bring the rest of the team with you.

· Elevate the performance of those around you : coaching senior engineers, strengthening how we design, review and ship.

· Lead the solution architecture conversations — bringing engineering, product and domain experts into the room and guiding them to decisions everyone trusts.

· Work pragmatically inside a vendor platform we don’t fully control — pushing it where it helps, working around it where it doesn’t.

· Be the person who gets to the bottom of the hard problems — the intermittent, cross\-layer, “nobody knows why” bugs that span generated code, data, tenancy and infrastructure.

· Build AI\-native workflows into both how we engineer and what our customers use.

**Essential Requirements**

· 5\+ years of senior web engineering leadership — setting technical direction and owning decisions on web/SaaS products — though we care far more about the calibre of your judgement than the number on your CV.

· Deep, current full\-stack experience across **.NET / C\#** and a modern front\-end framework with **TypeScript** — React, Angular or Vue. We build on Vue 3, but strong React or Angular engineers are just as welcome.

· A track record of **owning consequential architecture decisions under ambiguity** — and being right often enough to be trusted with the next one.

· Real experience of **multi\-tenant SaaS** and **cloud\-native delivery** on Azure (containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD).

· Exceptional **debugging and troubleshooting** instincts — you can reason from symptom to root cause across an unfamiliar, layered system.

· **Drive and initiative** — you move toward the hard problems and step up without being asked, motivated by shipping things customers value.

· The judgement to know **when** ***not*** **to engineer** — you build the right\-sized solution, resist gold\-plating, and ship rather than polish.

· **AI\-native engineering** — you already build with AI tooling, and you can design LLM\-backed product features (retrieval, semantic search, agents).

· The judgement and influence of someone who lifts a team rather than just out\-codes it — a natural coach who leads solution architecture discussions and brings people with them.

· Comfort evolving an established product toward cloud\-native without losing what makes it valuable.

**Our stack**

.NET / C\# · Vue 3 · TypeScript · Vite · Pinia · PostgreSQL · multi\-tenant SaaS · Azure · Kubernetes · Azure DevOps · real\-time messaging · a built\-in AI stack (semantic search, retrieval, agents).

**Why join us**

· Real problems and real ownership — you’ll shape the solution architecture.

· A rare mix: an established, profitable business with a genuine build\-from\-scratch product mission.

· A small, capable team where a Staff Engineer’s judgement carries real weight.

· Backing from a larger European agricultural software group.

· Hybrid working from our Pulborough

**What We Offer**

* The chance to shape a product used by thousands of UK farmers
* Investment in your development
* Yearly Performance bonus/Share of the Profits (if business delivers on profit)
* Hybrid working — 2\-3 days per week in our Pulborough office/home working
* Holiday allowance to include "birthday holiday" and office closure during Xmas period
* Pension scheme (5% employer contribution after qualifying period)
* Death in service
* Enhanced sick pay
* Private Health Insurance
* Company Events
* Nice office environment, casual dress code
* Free on\-site parking, near train station

**Landmark Systems Ltd** is an equal opportunities employer.

* Casual dress

* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
